a1-165.prompt: Tell Anna your plan for before and after lunch.
cues: Say what you do before lunch
Say what you do after lunch
a1-165.target: Ebéd előtt a park felé sétálunk. Ebéd után pihenünk.
a1-165.english: Before lunch we walk towards the park. After lunch we rest.
a1-165.canDo: I can plan a day with before, after and towards, like Ebéd előtt a park felé sétálunk.

a1-165-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Cat and Tea
a1-165-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) where the cat is and what you are drinking. The cat is behind the gate, and you drink tea instead of coffee.
a1-165-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly where the cat is and what you drink.
cues: Say where the cat is
Say what you drink instead of coffee
a1-165-consolidation.target: A macska a kapu mögött van. Kávé helyett teát iszom.
a1-165-consolidation.english: The cat is behind the gate. Instead of coffee I drink tea.
a1-165-consolidation.canDo: I can say where things are and what I do before, after and during, like A macska a kapu mögött van and Ebéd után pihenek.

a2-01.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day
a2-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her typical weekday. You (Meg) get up, shower and have breakfast in the morning, and you go to bed early in the evening.
a2-01.prompt: Tell Károly what you do in the morning and when you go to bed.
cues: Say you get up, shower and have breakfast
Say you go to bed early in the evening
a2-01.target: Reggel felkelek, zuhanyozom, és reggelizem. Este korán lefekszem.
a2-01.english: In the morning I get up, shower, and have breakfast. In the evening I go to bed early.
a2-01.canDo: I can describe the main events of a typical day.

a2-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Ready
a2-02.scenario: Károly wants to know how Meg gets ready in the morning. You (Meg) first wash up and brush your teeth, then get dressed, and finally have breakfast.
a2-02.prompt: Describe your morning routine to Károly in order: wash up and brush your teeth, then get dressed, and finally have breakfast.
cues: Say what you do first
Say what you do after that
Say what you do in the end
a2-02.target: Előbb mosakodom, aztán fogat mosok. Utána felöltözöm, végül reggelizem.
a2-02.english: First I wash up, then I brush my teeth. After that I get dressed, finally I have breakfast.
a2-02.canDo: I can describe how I get ready in the morning.

a2-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Day?
a2-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she does during the week. You (Meg) work on Tuesday, but on Saturday you have a day off.
a2-03.prompt: Tell Károly that you work on Tuesday, and that you do not work on Saturday because it is your day off.
cues: Say what you do on Tuesday
Say you do not work on Saturday and give the reason
a2-03.target: Kedden dolgozom. Szombaton nem dolgozom, mert szabadnapom van.
a2-03.english: I work on Tuesday. I don't work on Saturday because I have a day off.
a2-03.canDo: I can say what I do on a particular day of the week.

a2-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How Often?
a2-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how often she does sports and goes to the cinema. You (Meg) do sports twice a week and go to the cinema once a month.
a2-04.prompt: Answer Károly: say how many times a week you do sports and how many times a month you go to the cinema.
cues: Say how often you do sports
Say how often you go to the cinema
a2-04.target: Hetente kétszer sportolok, havonta egyszer moziba megyek.
a2-04.english: I do sports twice a week, I go to the cinema once a month.
a2-04.canDo: I can say how many times something happens.

a2-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Nine to Five
a2-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her working day. You (Meg) work from nine to five, and in the evening you are tired, so you rest.
a2-05.prompt: Tell Károly the hours you work, and that in the evening you are tired and so you rest.
cues: Say from when to when you work
Say you are tired in the evening and what you do because of it
a2-05.target: Kilenctől ötig dolgozom. Este fáradt vagyok, ezért pihenek.
a2-05.english: I work from nine to five. In the evening I am tired, so I rest.
a2-05.canDo: I can describe a span of time from one point to another.

a2-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Whole Day
a2-05-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg to describe a whole weekday and weekend. You (Meg) get up at seven, work from nine to five on weekdays, and sleep for a long time on the weekend.
a2-05-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly when you get up, when you work on weekdays, and what you do on the weekend.
cues: Say what time you get up
Say when you work on weekdays
Say you sleep for a long time on the weekend
a2-05-consolidation.target: Hétkor felkelek, hétköznap kilenctől ötig dolgozom. Hétvégén sokáig alszom.
a2-05-consolidation.english: I get up at seven, on weekdays I work from nine to five. On the weekend I sleep for a long time.
a2-05-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a full daily routine from getting up to going to bed.

a2-06.title: Communicative Challenge: This Week and Next
a2-06.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her weeks. You (Meg) work a lot this week, but next week you rest.
a2-06.prompt: Tell Károly that you work a lot this week, but that next week you are resting.
cues: Say what you do this week
Say what you do next week
a2-06.target: Ezen a héten sokat dolgozom, de jövő héten pihenek.
a2-06.english: This week I work a lot, but next week I'm resting.
a2-06.canDo: I can say this week, last week, and next week.

a2-07.title: Communicative Challenge: First and Second
a2-07.scenario: Károly looks at Meg's calendar. Her first Hungarian class is on 3rd October and her second is on the 10th.
a2-07.prompt: Tell Károly the dates of your first and second Hungarian classes in October.
cues: Say the date of the first class
Say the date of the second class
a2-07.target: Az első magyaróra október harmadikán van, a második tizedikén.
a2-07.english: The first Hungarian class is on October 3rd, the second on the 10th.
a2-07.canDo: I can count first through tenth.

a2-08.title: Communicative Challenge: Monday Morning
a2-08.scenario: Károly asks Meg when she is busy next week. You (Meg) work on Monday morning at nine, and you have Hungarian class on Tuesday evening at seven.
a2-08.prompt: Tell Károly exactly when you work and when you have Hungarian class.
cues: Say when you work: day, part of the day and time
Say when your Hungarian class is: day, part of the day and time
a2-08.target: Hétfőn reggel kilenckor dolgozom. Kedden este hétkor magyarórám van.
a2-08.english: On Monday morning at nine I work. On Tuesday evening at seven I have Hungarian class.
a2-08.canDo: I can combine a day, part of the day, and exact time in one sentence.

a2-09.title: Communicative Challenge: From Monday
a2-09.scenario: Károly asks Meg when her new job starts and what language she will speak. You (Meg) start on Monday, and from now on you speak Hungarian with Károly.
a2-09.prompt: Tell Károly that you start working on Monday and that from now on you speak Hungarian.
cues: Say from when you work
Say that from now on you speak Hungarian
a2-09.english: I work from Monday. From now on I speak Hungarian.
a2-09.canDo: I can say when something starts using -tól/-től.

a2-10.title: Communicative Challenge: My Weekly Schedule
a2-10.scenario: Károly asks to see Meg's weekly schedule. You (Meg) work from Monday to Thursday, and on Friday evening you have Hungarian class.
a2-10.prompt: Tell Károly your weekly schedule: when you work and when your Hungarian class is.
cues: Say which days you work
Say when your Hungarian class is
Say that this is your weekly schedule
a2-10.target: Hétfőtől csütörtökig dolgozom, pénteken este magyarórám van. Ez a heti beosztásom.
a2-10.english: I work from Monday to Thursday, on Friday evening I have Hungarian class. This is my weekly schedule.
a2-10.canDo: I can describe a whole weekly schedule by combining what I've learned.

a2-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Next Week's Plan
a2-10-consolidation.scenario: Károly wants to arrange a meeting with Meg. Next week you (Meg) work from Monday to Thursday, and on 10th October you have a dentist's appointment.
a2-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly when you work next week and the date of your dentist's appointment.
cues: Say when you work next week
Say you have an appointment and give the date
a2-10-consolidation.target: Jövő héten hétfőtől csütörtökig dolgozom. Október tizedikén van egy időpontom a fogorvosnál.
a2-10-consolidation.english: Next week I work from Monday to Thursday. On October 10th I have an appointment at the dentist's.
a2-10-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about weeks, months, and dates.

a2-11.title: Communicative Challenge: My Extended Family
a2-11.scenario: Meg is meeting Károly's parents, Gábor and Ildikó. Ildikó asks about Meg's relatives. You (Meg) have an uncle and an aunt, and a lot of cousins.
a2-11.prompt: Tell Ildikó which relatives you have: an uncle, an aunt and a lot of cousins.
cues: Say you have an uncle and an aunt
Say you have a lot of cousins
a2-11.target: Van egy nagybácsim és egy nagynénim. Sok unokatestvérem van.
a2-11.english: I have an uncle and an aunt. I have a lot of cousins.
a2-11.canDo: I can name extended family members.

a2-12.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is in the Photo?
a2-12.scenario: Ildikó looks at a photo on Meg's phone. It shows Meg's sister Anna, with her husband and her son.
a2-12.prompt: Tell Ildikó who is in the photo: your sister Anna, her husband and her son.
cues: Say the woman is your sister, Anna
Say who her husband is
Say who her son is
a2-12.target: Ez a testvérem, Anna. Ez a férje, és ez a fia.
a2-12.english: This is my sister, Anna. This is her husband, and this is her son.
a2-12.canDo: I can say "his/her X" for family members.

a2-13.title: Communicative Challenge: At His Parents' Place
a2-13.scenario: Meg's sister phones and asks where Meg is today. You (Meg) are at the place of Károly's parents, who live in Budapest.
a2-13.prompt: Tell your sister that Károly's parents live in Budapest and that today you are at their place.
cues: Say where Károly's parents live
Say that today you are at their place
a2-13.target: Károly szülei Budapesten laknak. Ma a szüleinél vagyok.
a2-13.english: Károly's parents live in Budapest. Today I'm at his parents' place.

a2-14.title: Communicative Challenge: Visiting the Family
a2-14.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the coming Sunday. You (Meg) are visiting Károly's parents, and the whole family often gets together.
a2-14.prompt: Tell Károly that on Sunday you are visiting his parents, and that the family often gets together.
cues: Say you are visiting his parents on Sunday
Say that the family gets together often
a2-14.target: Vasárnap meglátogatom Károly szüleit. A család gyakran összejön.
a2-14.english: On Sunday I'm visiting Károly's parents. The family often gets together.
a2-14.canDo: I can talk about visiting family and getting together.

a2-15.title: Communicative Challenge: A Little Nervous
a2-15.scenario: Meg's sister phones before Meg visits Károly's parents for the first time. You (Meg) are a little nervous, but they are very kind.
a2-15.prompt: Tell your sister that you are visiting Károly's parents today, that you are a little nervous, and that they are very kind.
cues: Say you are visiting his parents today
Say you are a little nervous
Say they are very kind
a2-15.target: Ma meglátogatom Károly szüleit. Egy kicsit izgulok, de nagyon kedvesek.
a2-15.english: Today I'm visiting Károly's parents. I'm a little nervous, but they are very kind.
a2-15.canDo: I can describe a family visit from start to finish.

a2-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family
a2-15-consolidation.scenario: Gábor and Ildikó ask Meg about her family. You (Meg) have a lot of cousins, your aunt lives in Budapest, and on Sunday you are at Károly's parents' place.
a2-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gábor and Ildikó about your cousins and your aunt, and where you are on Sunday.
cues: Say you have a lot of cousins
Say where your aunt lives
Say where you are on Sunday
a2-15-consolidation.target: Sok unokatestvérem van, és a nagynéném Budapesten lakik. Vasárnap Károly szüleinél vagyok.
a2-15-consolidation.english: I have a lot of cousins, and my aunt lives in Budapest. On Sunday I'm at Károly's parents' place.
a2-15-consolidation.canDo: I can name and describe extended family members.

a2-16.title: Communicative Challenge: What Does He Look Like?
a2-16.scenario: Károly asks Meg what her neighbour Tamás looks like. He has a beard and glasses, and his hair is black.
a2-16.prompt: Describe your neighbour to Károly: he has a beard and wears glasses, and his hair is black.
cues: Say he has a beard and wears glasses
Say what colour his hair is
a2-16.target: A szomszédom szakállas és szemüveges. Fekete haja van.
a2-16.english: My neighbour has a beard and wears glasses. He has black hair.
a2-16.canDo: I can describe someone's hair and other features.

a2-17.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Colleague
a2-17.scenario: Károly asks Meg what her new colleague is like. She is smart, hardworking and patient, but a little serious.
a2-17.prompt: Tell Károly what your colleague is like: she is smart, hardworking and patient, but serious.
cues: Say she is smart and hardworking
Say she is patient but serious
a2-17.target: A kollégám okos és szorgalmas. Türelmes, de komoly.
a2-17.english: My colleague is smart and hardworking. She is patient, but serious.
a2-17.canDo: I can describe someone's personality with more detail.

a2-18.title: Communicative Challenge: Different People
a2-18.scenario: Károly asks whether Meg's colleague and her neighbour are alike. They are very different: the colleague is serious, the neighbour is funny.
a2-18.prompt: Tell Károly that your colleague and your neighbour are very different, and say how.
cues: Say the two people are very different
Say which one is serious and which one is funny
a2-18.target: A kollégám és a szomszédom nagyon különbözőek. A kollégám komoly, a szomszédom vicces.
a2-18.english: My colleague and my neighbour are very different. My colleague is serious, my neighbour is funny.
a2-18.canDo: I can say two people or things are similar or different.

a2-19.title: Communicative Challenge: Someone Who Helps
a2-19.scenario: Károly asks Meg who she knows at work and in the building. You (Meg) have a colleague who is hardworking and friendly, and you know a neighbour who is very funny.
a2-19.prompt: Tell Károly about a colleague who is hardworking and friendly, and a neighbour who is very funny.
cues: Describe your colleague with a who-clause
Say you know a funny neighbour
a2-19.target: Van egy kollégám, aki szorgalmas és barátságos. Ismerek egy szomszédot, aki nagyon vicces.
a2-19.english: I have a colleague who is hardworking and friendly. I know a neighbour who is very funny.
a2-19.canDo: I can describe someone using a whole clause with aki.

a2-20.title: Communicative Challenge: Petra and Tamás
a2-20.scenario: Károly asks Meg about two new people in her life: her colleague Petra and her neighbour Tamás.
a2-20.prompt: Introduce Petra and Tamás to Károly: Petra is a hardworking, friendly colleague, and Tamás is a bearded neighbour.
cues: Say who Petra is and what she is like
Say who Tamás is and what he looks like
a2-20.target: Petra a kolléganőm, aki nagyon szorgalmas és barátságos. Tamás a szomszédom, aki szakállas.
a2-20.english: Petra is my colleague, who is very hardworking and friendly. Tamás is my neighbour, who has a beard.
a2-20.canDo: I can give a full description of a new person in my life.

a2-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Comparing People
a2-20-consolidation.scenario: Károly wants to know more about Tamás. He wears glasses and has a beard, and he is as friendly as Meg's colleague Petra.
a2-20-consolidation.prompt: Describe Tamás to Károly: what he looks like, and that he is as friendly as Petra.
cues: Say he wears glasses and has a beard
Compare how friendly he is with Petra
a2-20-consolidation.target: A szomszédom szemüveges és szakállas, és olyan barátságos, mint a kolléganőm.
a2-20-consolidation.english: My neighbour wears glasses and has a beard, and he is as friendly as my colleague.
a2-20-consolidation.canDo: I can describe someone's appearance and personality in detail.

a2-21.title: Communicative Challenge: Friend or Acquaintance?
a2-21.scenario: Károly asks Meg who Petra and Tamás are to her. You (Meg) say that Petra is your friend, and Tamás is only an acquaintance, not a close friend.
a2-21.prompt: Tell Károly that Petra is your friend, and that Tamás is just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
cues: Say Petra is your friend
Say Tamás is only an acquaintance, not a close friend
a2-21.target: Petra a barátnőm. Tamás csak egy ismerős, nem közeli barát.
a2-21.english: Petra is my friend. Tamás is just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
a2-21.canDo: I can distinguish a friend from an acquaintance.

a2-22.title: Communicative Challenge: Meeting New People
a2-22.scenario: Károly asks how Meg gets to know people in a new city. You (Meg) meet new people at work and through Petra.
a2-22.prompt: Tell Károly where you meet new people, and that you get to know a lot of people through Petra.
cues: Say where you get to know new people
Say that you meet many people through Petra
a2-22.target: A munkahelyen ismerkedem új emberekkel. Petrán keresztül sok emberrel ismerkedem.
a2-22.english: I get to know new people at work. I get to know a lot of people through Petra.
a2-22.canDo: I can talk about how people get to know each other.

a2-23.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Along with Petra
a2-23.scenario: Károly asks Meg how things are with Petra. You (Meg) get along well with her, and the two of you talk a lot.
a2-23.prompt: Tell Károly that you get along well with Petra, and that you talk a lot.
cues: Say you get along well with Petra
Say you talk a lot
a2-23.target: Jól kijövök Petrával, és sokat beszélünk.
a2-23.english: I get along well with Petra, and we talk a lot.
a2-23.canDo: I can say I get along well (or not) with someone.

a2-24.title: Communicative Challenge: Making Friends Easily
a2-24.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether it is hard for her to make friends in Budapest. You (Meg) are open, so you make friends easily, and you like meeting new people.
a2-24.prompt: Tell Károly that you are open, that you make friends easily, and that you like making friends with new people.
cues: Say you are open and make friends easily
Say you like making friends with new people
a2-24.target: Nyitott vagyok, ezért könnyen barátkozom. Szeretek barátkozni új emberekkel.
a2-24.english: I'm open, so I make friends easily. I like making friends with new people.
a2-24.canDo: I can say whether I make friends easily.

a2-25.title: Communicative Challenge: Petra, My Friend
a2-25.scenario: Károly asks Meg to sum up her friendship with Petra. Petra is not only your colleague but also your friend; you get along well and talk a lot.
a2-25.prompt: Tell Károly that Petra is not only your colleague but also your friend, and that you get along well and talk a lot.
cues: Say Petra is not only a colleague but also a friend
Say you get along well and talk a lot
a2-25.target: Petra nem csak kolléganőm, hanem a barátnőm is. Jól kijövünk egymással, és sokat beszélünk.
a2-25.english: Petra isn't just my colleague, she's also my friend. We get along well with each other, and we talk a lot.
a2-25.canDo: I can describe a real friendship from start to finish.

a2-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Life of My Own
a2-25-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she feels in Budapest. You (Meg) say that Petra is not only your colleague but also your friend, that you get along well, and that now you have a life of your own here.
a2-25-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly about your friendship with Petra and that you now have a life of your own in Budapest.
cues: Say Petra is more than a colleague
Say you get along well
Say you have a life of your own here
a2-25-consolidation.target: Petra nem csak kolléganőm, hanem barátnőm is. Jól kijövünk egymással, és most saját életem van itt.
a2-25-consolidation.english: Petra isn't just my colleague, she's also my friend. We get along well with each other, and now I have a life of my own here.
a2-25-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about friends, acquaintances, and how people meet.

a2-26.title: Communicative Challenge: Moving Day
a2-26.scenario: Károly asks Meg where they live and where they are moving. You (Meg) currently live on the third floor, but today you are moving into a new flat.
a2-26.prompt: Tell Károly that you live on the third floor now, but today you are moving into a new flat.
cues: Say what floor you live on now
Say you are moving into a new flat today
a2-26.target: Most a harmadik emeleten lakunk, de ma új lakásba költözünk.
a2-26.english: We live on the third floor now, but today we are moving into a new flat.
a2-26.canDo: I can say what floor I live on.

a2-27.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Room
a2-27.scenario: Károly asks where things are in the new room. The shelf is on the wall, and the clothes are in the wardrobe.
a2-27.prompt: Tell Károly where the shelf is and where the clothes are.
cues: Say where the shelf is
Say where the clothes are
a2-27.target: A polc a falon van. A ruhák a szekrényben vannak.
a2-27.english: The shelf is on the wall. The clothes are in the wardrobe.
a2-27.canDo: I can describe where furniture is in a room.

a2-28.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are My Keys?
a2-28.scenario: Károly is looking for things in the new flat. The key is in the drawer, and the shoes are on the rug.
a2-28.prompt: Tell Károly where the key is and where the shoes are.
cues: Say where the key is
Say where the shoes are
a2-28.target: A kulcs a fiókban van. A cipő a szőnyegen van.
a2-28.english: The key is in the drawer. The shoes are on the rug.
a2-28.canDo: I can choose the right locative suffix for in, on, or at.

a2-29.title: Communicative Challenge: Boxes and Shelves
a2-29.scenario: Károly and Meg are unpacking boxes in the new flat. You (Meg) put a box onto the shelf, and take a book off the table.
a2-29.prompt: Tell Károly that you are putting the box onto the shelf, and taking the book off the table.
cues: Say you put the box onto the shelf
Say you take the book off the table
a2-29.target: A dobozt a polcra teszem. A könyvet leveszem az asztalról.
a2-29.english: I put the box onto the shelf. I take the book off the table.
a2-29.canDo: I can say I'm putting something onto a surface.

a2-30.title: Communicative Challenge: Our New Home
a2-30.scenario: At the end of moving day, Károly asks Meg what they did with their things. You (Meg) put the books onto the shelf and the clothes into the wardrobe, and the building has a garage and a cellar too.
a2-30.prompt: Tell Károly where the books and clothes go, and what else the building has.
cues: Say where you put the books and the clothes
Say that the building has a garage and a cellar too
a2-30.target: A könyveket a polcra tesszük, a ruhákat a szekrénybe. A házban van garázs és pince is.
a2-30.english: We put the books onto the shelf, the clothes into the wardrobe. There's a garage and a cellar too in the building.
a2-30.canDo: I can describe moving into and arranging a new home.

a2-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Settling In
a2-30-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the new flat. It is on the second floor, you put the clothes into the wardrobe, and the boxes onto the floor.
a2-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what floor the new flat is on, and where you put the clothes and the boxes.
cues: Say what floor the flat is on
Say where the clothes and the boxes go
a2-30-consolidation.target: Az új lakás a második emeleten van. A ruhákat a szekrénybe tesszük, a dobozokat a padlóra.
a2-30-consolidation.english: The new flat is on the second floor. We put the clothes into the wardrobe, the boxes onto the floor.
a2-30-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a home using -ban/-ben and -on/-en/-ön correctly.

a2-31.title: Communicative Challenge: To the Bakery
a2-31.scenario: Károly phones Meg and asks where she is going. You (Meg) are going to the bakery on the corner, because you like this neighbourhood.
a2-31.prompt: Tell Károly that you are going to the bakery, and that you like this neighbourhood.
cues: Say where you are going
Say you like this neighbourhood
a2-31.target: A pékséghez megyek. Szeretem ezt a szomszédságot.
a2-31.english: I'm going to the bakery. I like this neighbourhood.
a2-31.canDo: I can say I'm going to a place using -hoz/-hez/-höz.

a2-32.title: Communicative Challenge: Close to the River
a2-32.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is near their new flat. The park is close to the river, and the bakery is close to the bridge.
a2-32.prompt: Tell Károly that the park is close to the river and the bakery is close to the bridge.
cues: Say what the park is close to
Say what the bakery is close to
a2-32.target: A park közel van a folyóhoz. A pékség közel van a hídhoz.
a2-32.english: The park is close to the river. The bakery is close to the bridge.
a2-32.canDo: I can say what's close to or far from a place.

a2-33.title: Communicative Challenge: Places in Our District
a2-33.scenario: Károly asks Meg what there is in their district. There is a police station, a theatre and a statue.
a2-33.prompt: Tell Károly that in this district there is a police station, a theatre and a statue too.
cues: Name the three places in this district
a2-33.target: Ebben a negyedben van rendőrség, színház és szobor is.
a2-33.english: In this district there is a police station, a theatre and a statue too.
a2-33.canDo: I can name more places in the city.

a2-34.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You?
a2-34.scenario: Károly phones Meg and asks where she is. You (Meg) are coming from the bridge, you are at the bakery now, and you are going on to the church.
a2-34.prompt: Tell Károly where you are coming from, where you are now, and where you are going.
cues: Say where you are coming from
Say where you are now
Say where you are going
a2-34.target: A hídtól jövök, a pékségnél vagyok, és a templomhoz megyek.
a2-34.english: I'm coming from the bridge, I'm at the bakery, and I'm going to the church.
a2-34.canDo: I can say where I am, where I'm going, and where I'm coming from.

a2-35.title: Communicative Challenge: My Neighbourhood
a2-35.scenario: Károly asks Meg what their neighbourhood is like. It is calm, not busy, and Meg has a favourite bakery on the corner.
a2-35.prompt: Tell Károly that the district is calm and not busy, and that you have a favourite bakery on the corner.
cues: Describe the district
Say where your favourite bakery is
a2-35.target: A negyedünk nyugodt, nem forgalmas. Van egy kedvenc pékségem a sarkon.
a2-35.english: Our district is calm, not busy. I have a favourite bakery on the corner.
a2-35.canDo: I can describe what my neighbourhood is like.

a2-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Around the Corner
a2-35-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg where she is. The bakery is close to the bridge; you are coming from the church and going to the bakery.
a2-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the bakery is close to the bridge, where you are coming from and where you are going.
cues: Say what the bakery is close to
Say where you are coming from and where you are going
a2-35-consolidation.target: A pékség közel van a hídhoz. Most a templomtól jövök, és a pékséghez megyek.
a2-35-consolidation.english: The bakery is close to the bridge. Now I'm coming from the church, and I'm going to the bakery.
a2-35-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about my neighbourhood and the places in it, using -hoz/-hez/-höz.

a2-36.title: Communicative Challenge: A Gift for Anna
a2-36.scenario: Meg and Károly are at the market, looking for a birthday present for Anna. The shop assistant asks what Meg is looking for. You (Meg) are looking for a blue sweater for Anna.
a2-36.prompt: Tell the shop assistant that you are looking for a blue sweater for Anna.
cues: Say what you are looking for
Say who it is for
a2-36.english: I'm looking for a blue sweater for Anna.
a2-36.canDo: I can say what I'm looking for in a shop.

a2-37.title: Communicative Challenge: Size and Colour
a2-37.scenario: The shop assistant shows Meg a sweater for Anna's present. You (Meg) want a medium size; this one is too big, and you would like to know if there is green too.
a2-37.prompt: Tell the shop assistant the size you want, that this one is too big, and ask if there is green.
cues: Say what size you want
Say this one is too big
Ask whether there is green
a2-37.target: Közepes méretet keresek. Ez túl nagy. Van zöld is?
a2-37.english: I'm looking for a medium size. This one is too big. Is there green too?
a2-37.canDo: I can ask for and describe a size.

a2-38.title: Communicative Challenge: How Much Is It?
a2-38.scenario: Meg is in the shop with Károly and wants to know the price of the sweater. You (Meg) ask the shop assistant how much it costs, and then say that five hundred forints is a very good price.
a2-38.prompt: Ask the shop assistant how much the sweater costs, then say that five hundred forints would be a very good price.
cues: Ask the price
Say that five hundred forints is a good price
a2-38.target: Mennyibe kerül ez a pulóver? Ötezer forintért ez nagyon jó ár.
a2-38.english: How much does this sweater cost? For five thousand forints this is a very good price.
a2-38.canDo: I can use numbers well past twenty for prices and quantities.

a2-39.title: Communicative Challenge: Blue or Green?
a2-39.scenario: Károly asks Meg which sweater she wants for Anna. The blue one is not as cheap as the green one, so you would rather buy the green one.
a2-39.prompt: Tell Károly that the blue sweater is not as cheap as the green one, and that you would rather buy the green one.
cues: Compare the blue and the green sweater
Say which one you would rather buy
a2-39.target: A kék pulóver nem olyan olcsó, mint a zöld. Inkább a zöld pulóvert veszem.
a2-39.english: The blue sweater isn't as cheap as the green one. I'd rather buy the green sweater.
a2-39.canDo: I can compare two products using olyan..., mint...

a2-40.title: Communicative Challenge: My Choice
a2-40.scenario: The shop assistant asks which sweater Meg is choosing for Anna. You (Meg) choose this one, for three thousand forints, and you are sure.
a2-40.prompt: Tell the shop assistant that you are choosing this sweater for three thousand forints and that you are sure.
cues: Say what you are choosing and for how much
Say that you are sure
a2-40.target: Ezt a pulóvert választom háromezer forintért, mert szép.
a2-40.english: I'm choosing this sweater for three thousand forints, because it's nice.
a2-40.canDo: I can choose confidently between products.

a2-40-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Right Sweater
a2-40-consolidation.scenario: Meg is at the market shop with Károly, looking for a present for Anna. The shop assistant asks what she wants. You (Meg) are looking for a medium green sweater, and you want to know the price.
a2-40-consolidation.prompt: Tell the shop assistant what size and colour you are looking for, and ask how much it costs.
cues: Say what you are looking for
Ask the price
a2-40-consolidation.target: Közepes, zöld pulóvert keresek Annának. Mennyibe kerül?
a2-40-consolidation.english: I'm looking for a medium green sweater for Anna. How much does it cost?
a2-40-consolidation.canDo: I can shop for sizes, colours, and prices using numbers past ten.

a2-41.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do I Eat and Drink?
a2-41.scenario: Gábor asks Meg what she eats and drinks in the morning and today at Sunday lunch. You (Meg) eat bread and drink tea in the morning, and today you are having soup.
a2-41.prompt: Tell Gábor what you eat and drink in the morning, and what you are eating today.
cues: Say what you eat and drink in the morning
Say what you are eating today
a2-41.target: Reggel kenyeret eszem és teát iszom. Ma levest eszem.
a2-41.english: In the morning I eat bread and drink tea. Today I'm eating soup.
a2-41.canDo: I can conjugate eszik and iszik in the present tense.

a2-42.title: Communicative Challenge: Four Meals a Day
a2-42.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how many times a day she eats. You (Meg) eat four times a day: breakfast, lunch, an afternoon snack and dinner.
a2-42.prompt: Tell Ildikó how many times a day you eat, and name the meals.
cues: Say how many times a day you eat
Name the four meals
a2-42.target: Naponta négyszer eszem: reggelizem, ebédelek, uzsonnázom és vacsorázom.
a2-42.english: I eat four times a day: I have breakfast, lunch, an afternoon snack and dinner.
a2-42.canDo: I can say how many times a day I do something, with any number.

a2-43.title: Communicative Challenge: How Often Do You Eat It?
a2-43.scenario: Gábor asks Meg about her eating habits. You (Meg) eat meat three times a week and drink coffee twice a day.
a2-43.prompt: Tell Gábor how often you eat meat and how often you drink coffee.
cues: Say how often you eat meat
Say how often you drink coffee
a2-43.target: Hetente háromszor eszem húst. Naponta kétszer iszom kávét.
a2-43.english: I eat meat three times a week. I drink coffee twice a day.
a2-43.canDo: I can describe how often I eat or drink something.

a2-44.title: Communicative Challenge: The Soup on the Table
a2-44.scenario: At Sunday lunch Ildikó asks Meg what she thinks of Hungarian food. You (Meg) like it, and you are eating the soup in front of you because it has a lot of good spice.
a2-44.prompt: Tell Ildikó that you like Hungarian cuisine, and that you are eating the soup because there is a lot of spice in it.
cues: Say you like Hungarian cuisine
Say you are eating the soup and why
a2-44.target: Szeretem a magyar konyhát, mert sok fűszer van az ételekben.
a2-44.english: I like Hungarian cuisine, because there's a lot of spice in the food.
a2-44.canDo: I can choose the definite form of a verb when the object is a specific thing.

a2-45.title: Communicative Challenge: My Favourite Meal
a2-45.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how she likes the family's Sunday lunch. You (Meg) say that the soup tastes really good, and that Sunday lunch is your favourite.
a2-45.prompt: Tell Ildikó that the soup tastes really good, and that Sunday lunch is your favourite.
cues: Say the soup tastes good
Say Sunday lunch is your favourite
a2-45.target: Nagyon ízlik a leves! A vasárnapi ebéd a kedvencem.
a2-45.english: The soup tastes really good! Sunday lunch is my favourite.
a2-45.canDo: I can describe a favourite meal from start to finish.

a2-45-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Sunday Lunch Habit
a2-45-consolidation.scenario: Gábor asks Meg what she thinks of the Sunday lunches. Once a week you have lunch together, it is your habit, and you eat the soup, which tastes very good.
a2-45-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gábor how often you have lunch together, and that you are eating the soup and it tastes very good.
cues: Say how often you have lunch together
Say you are eating the soup and it tastes good
a2-45-consolidation.target: Hetente egyszer együtt ebédelünk, ez a szokásunk. A leves nagyon ízlik.
a2-45-consolidation.english: Once a week we have lunch together, this is our habit. The soup tastes really good.
a2-45-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about food, meals, and how often I eat.

a2-46.title: Communicative Challenge: What Does the Recipe Need?
a2-46.scenario: Ildikó invites Meg into her kitchen to learn the family goulash recipe, and asks what ingredients a good recipe needs. You (Meg) say it needs meat, onion, paprika, pepper and salt.
a2-46.prompt: Tell Ildikó the main ingredients and spices the dish needs.
cues: Name the ingredients and spices the dish needs
a2-46.target: Hús, hagyma, paprika, bors és só kell hozzá.
a2-46.english: It needs meat, onion, paprika, pepper and salt.
a2-46.canDo: I can name the main ingredients and spices in a recipe.

a2-47.title: Communicative Challenge: Knife, Fork and Spoon
a2-47.scenario: Ildikó and Meg talk about cooking tools in the kitchen. You (Meg) eat the soup with a spoon, and the meat with a knife and fork.
a2-47.prompt: Tell Ildikó what you eat the soup with, and what you eat the meat with.
cues: Say what you eat the soup with
Say what you eat the meat with
a2-47.target: A levest kanállal eszem. A húst késsel és villával eszem.
a2-47.english: I eat the soup with a spoon. I eat the meat with a knife and fork.
a2-47.canDo: I can name basic cooking tools.

a2-48.title: Communicative Challenge: Let's Cook Together
a2-48.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how she would write down the first steps of the recipe. You (Meg) say: cut some onion, boil some water, and suggest cooking together.
a2-48.prompt: Give Ildikó the first two steps as commands, and suggest that you cook together.
cues: Tell someone to cut onion and boil water
Suggest cooking together
a2-48.target: Vágj hagymát, aztán forralj vizet! Főzzünk együtt!
a2-48.english: Cut some onion, then boil some water! Let's cook together!
a2-48.canDo: I can give a simple cooking instruction using the imperative.

a2-49.title: Communicative Challenge: Cut It Up
a2-49.scenario: Ildikó is writing down the goulash recipe and asks Meg for the next steps. You (Meg) say: cut up the onion, then add the meat.
a2-49.prompt: Give Ildikó two instructions: cut up the onion, then add the meat.
cues: Tell someone to cut up the onion
Tell someone to add the meat
a2-49.target: Vágd fel a hagymát! Add hozzá a húst!
a2-49.english: Cut up the onion! Add the meat!
a2-49.canDo: I can give a command about a specific, definite thing.

a2-50.title: Communicative Challenge: Making Gulyás
a2-50.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg to explain how the goulash is made. You (Meg) cut up the onion and the garlic, put them into the pot, then put in the meat and the paprika too.
a2-50.prompt: Explain to Ildikó how to make the dish, step by step.
cues: Say to cut up the onion and the garlic
Say to put them in the pot and then add the meat and paprika
a2-50.target: Vágd fel a hagymát és a fokhagymát. Tedd a fazékba, aztán tedd bele a húst és a paprikát is.
a2-50.english: Cut up the onion and the garlic. Put them in the pot, then put the meat and the paprika into it too.
a2-50.canDo: I can describe making a traditional Hungarian dish from start to finish.

a2-50-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Goulash Card
a2-50-consolidation.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg to write the goulash recipe card. You (Meg) say what the dish needs and give one step with a knife.
a2-50-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ildikó which ingredients the goulash needs, and tell her to cut up the onion with a knife.
cues: Say what the goulash needs
Tell her to cut up the onion with a knife
a2-50-consolidation.target: A gulyáshoz hús, hagyma és paprika kell. Vágd fel a hagymát késsel!
a2-50-consolidation.english: The goulash needs meat, onion and paprika. Cut up the onion with a knife!
a2-50-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about ingredients, spices, and cooking tools.

a2-51.title: Communicative Challenge: Free-Time Hobbies
a2-51.scenario: On a quiet Saturday Károly asks Meg what she likes doing in her free time. You (Meg) like drawing and taking photographs, but you don't like gardening.
a2-51.prompt: Tell Károly which hobbies you like in your free time, and which one you don't.
cues: Say you like drawing and photography in your free time
Say what you don't like doing
a2-51.target: Szabadidőmben szeretek rajzolni és fényképezni. Nem szeretek kertészkedni.
a2-51.english: In my free time I like drawing and taking photographs. I don't like gardening.
a2-51.canDo: I can name several common hobbies.

a2-52.title: Communicative Challenge: Going Swimming
a2-52.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she does any sport. You (Meg) go swimming on Mondays and Wednesdays, and you have been running for two years.
a2-52.prompt: Tell Károly which sports you do regularly and how long you have been running.
cues: Say when you go swimming
Say how long you have been running
a2-52.target: Hétfőn és szerdán úszni járok. Két éve futok.
a2-52.english: I go swimming on Mondays and Wednesdays. I've been running for two years.
a2-52.canDo: I can talk about sports I do regularly.

a2-53.title: Communicative Challenge: What Interests Me
a2-53.scenario: Károly asks Meg what interests her. You (Meg) are very interested in music, and you hate being bored.
a2-53.prompt: Tell Károly that music interests you very much, and that you hate being bored.
cues: Say that music interests you
Say that you hate being bored
a2-53.target: Engem nagyon érdekel a zene. Utálom, ha unatkozom.
a2-53.english: I'm very interested in music. I hate it when I'm bored.
a2-53.canDo: I can say what interests me using engem érdekel.

a2-54.title: Communicative Challenge: How Often?
a2-54.scenario: Károly asks Meg how often she swims. You (Meg) go swimming twice a week, and you swim a lot every summer.
a2-54.prompt: Tell Károly how many times a week you go swimming and that you swim a lot every summer.
cues: Say how often you go swimming in a week
Say what you do every summer
a2-54.target: Hetente kétszer úszni járok. Nyaranta sokat úszom.
a2-54.english: I go swimming twice a week. I swim a lot every summer.
a2-54.canDo: I can say exactly how many times a day or a week I do something.

a2-55.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekend Plans
a2-55.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she is doing next weekend. You (Meg) are going hiking, but it depends on the weather.
a2-55.prompt: Tell Károly that you are going hiking next weekend, but that it depends on the weather.
cues: Say what you are doing next weekend
Say it depends on the weather
a2-55.target: Jövő hétvégén kirándulunk. Attól függ, hogy milyen az idő.
a2-55.english: We're going hiking next weekend. It depends on what the weather's like.
a2-55.canDo: I can talk about my weekend plans.

a2-55-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: No More Boredom
a2-55-consolidation.scenario: Károly wants to plan some activities with Meg so she isn't bored. You (Meg) go swimming twice a week, you are going hiking next weekend, and that depends on the weather.
a2-55-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly how often you go swimming, and that you are going hiking next weekend if the weather allows.
cues: Say how often you go swimming
Say you are hiking next weekend and that it depends on the weather
a2-55-consolidation.target: Hetente kétszer úszni járok. Jövő hétvégén kirándulunk, de attól függ, hogy milyen az idő.
a2-55-consolidation.english: I go swimming twice a week. We're going hiking next weekend, but it depends on what the weather's like.
a2-55-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about my hobbies and how often I do them.

a2-56.title: Communicative Challenge: Films I Like
a2-56.scenario: Petra phones Meg and asks what kind of films she likes. You (Meg) like action films, and tonight you are watching a comedy.
a2-56.prompt: Tell Petra which kind of film you like, and what kind you are watching tonight.
cues: Say you like action films
Say you are watching a comedy tonight
a2-56.target: Szeretem az akciófilmeket. Ma este egy vígjátékot nézünk.
a2-56.english: I like action films. Tonight we're watching a comedy.
a2-56.canDo: I can name different kinds of films.

a2-57.title: Communicative Challenge: Do You Play an Instrument?
a2-57.scenario: Petra phones Meg about Zsófia's concert and asks whether Meg plays an instrument. You (Meg) play the piano, and your favourite singer is Zsófia.
a2-57.prompt: Tell Petra what instrument you play and who your favourite singer is.
cues: Say what instrument you play
Say who your favourite singer is
a2-57.target: Zongorán játszom. A kedvenc énekesem Zsófia.
a2-57.english: I play the piano. My favourite singer is Zsófia.
a2-57.canDo: I can say what instrument I play.

a2-58.title: Communicative Challenge: The Book I'm Reading
a2-58.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the book she is reading. You (Meg) say that the novel you are reading is very exciting, and give your opinion.
a2-58.prompt: Tell Károly that the novel you are reading is very exciting, and that in your opinion it is a good story.
cues: Describe the novel with a relative clause
Give your opinion of the story
a2-58.target: A regény, amit olvasok, nagyon izgalmas. Szerintem jó történet.
a2-58.english: The novel that I'm reading is very exciting. In my opinion it's a good story.
a2-58.canDo: I can describe a book or story using a relative clause with ami.

a2-59.title: Communicative Challenge: An Exhibition for You
a2-59.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she can recommend for the weekend. You (Meg) recommend a good exhibition, which is closed on Mondays.
a2-59.prompt: Recommend a good exhibition to Petra, and tell her that it is closed on Mondays.
cues: Recommend an exhibition to her
Say when it is closed
a2-59.target: Ajánlok neked egy jó kiállítást. Hétfőn zárva van.
a2-59.english: I recommend a good exhibition to you. It's closed on Mondays.
a2-59.canDo: I can recommend an exhibition, festival, or event to someone.

a2-60.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Say?
a2-60.scenario: In the evening Meg talks over Petra's invitation with Károly. You (Meg) suggest going to the concert on Saturday and ask him what he thinks.
a2-60.prompt: Suggest to Károly that you go to a concert on Saturday, and ask what he thinks.
cues: Suggest a concert on Saturday
Ask what he thinks
a2-60.target: Javaslok egy koncertet szombaton. Mit szólsz hozzá?
a2-60.english: I suggest a concert on Saturday. What do you think?
a2-60.canDo: I can suggest going out and ask what someone thinks.

a2-60-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Taste
a2-60-consolidation.scenario: Petra phones Meg to chat about what she likes. You (Meg) think comedies are good films, you play the piano, and your favourite singer is Zsófia.
a2-60-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra your opinion of comedies, what instrument you play, and who your favourite singer is.
cues: Give your opinion about comedies
Say what instrument you play and who your favourite singer is
a2-60-consolidation.target: Szerintem a vígjáték jó film. Zongorán játszom, és a kedvenc énekesem Zsófia.
a2-60-consolidation.english: In my opinion a comedy is a good film. I play the piano, and my favourite singer is Zsófia.
a2-60-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about films, music, and books I like.

a2-61.title: Communicative Challenge: What's the Weather Like?
a2-61.scenario: On a warm Friday evening Károly asks Meg what the weather is like. It is nice, sunny and warm; the sun is shining and the wind is not blowing.
a2-61.prompt: Tell Károly what the weather is like, and that the sun is shining and the wind is not blowing.
cues: Say the weather is nice, sunny and warm
Say the sun is shining and there is no wind
a2-61.target: Szép idő van, napos és meleg. Süt a nap, nem fúj a szél.
a2-61.english: The weather is nice, sunny and warm. The sun is shining, the wind isn't blowing.
a2-61.canDo: I can ask and say what the weather is like.

a2-62.title: Communicative Challenge: My Seasons
a2-62.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her favourite season. You (Meg) say that in spring everything is green, and in summer it is very hot.
a2-62.prompt: Tell Károly what spring and summer are like.
cues: Say what spring is like
Say what summer is like
a2-62.target: Tavasszal minden zöld. Nyáron nagyon meleg van.
a2-62.english: In spring everything is green. In summer it's very hot.
a2-62.canDo: I can name the four seasons and say what happens in each one.

a2-63.title: Communicative Challenge: Rain on Saturday
a2-63.scenario: On Saturday morning Károly looks out of the window. You (Meg) say that it is raining and the street is wet, and that it is already snowing in November.
a2-63.prompt: Tell Károly that it is raining and the street is wet, and that in November it is already snowing.
cues: Say it is raining and the street is wet
Say that in November it already snows
a2-63.target: Esik az eső, és az utca vizes. Novemberben már esik a hó.
a2-63.english: It's raining, and the street is wet. In November it's already snowing.
a2-63.canDo: I can say it's raining or snowing.

a2-64.title: Communicative Challenge: How Many Degrees?
a2-64.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether it is warm outside. You (Meg) say it is cool in the morning but warm in the afternoon, and ask how many degrees it is.
a2-64.prompt: Tell Károly that it is cool in the morning but warm in the afternoon, and ask how many degrees it is.
cues: Say how it is in the morning and the afternoon
Ask how many degrees it is
a2-64.target: Reggel hűvös van, de délután meleg. Hány fok van?
a2-64.english: In the morning it's cool, but in the afternoon it's warm. How many degrees is it?
a2-64.canDo: I can describe hot, cold and cool weather, and ask how many degrees it is.

a2-65.title: Communicative Challenge: If It Rains
a2-65.scenario: Károly asks what Meg wants to do at the weekend. You (Meg) stay at home if it rains, and go to the park if the weather is nice.
a2-65.prompt: Tell Károly what you do if it rains and what you do if the weather is nice.
cues: Say what you do if it rains
Say what you do if the weather is nice
a2-65.target: Ha esik az eső, otthon maradok. Ha szép idő van, a parkba megyünk.
a2-65.english: If it rains, I'll stay at home. If the weather's nice, we'll go to the park.
a2-65.canDo: I can say what I'll do depending on the weather, using ha.

a2-65-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Saturday Morning
a2-65-consolidation.scenario: On Saturday morning Meg and Károly look at the sky. It is cloudy and windy, and if it rains you will stay at home.
a2-65-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the weather is like today, and that you stay at home if it rains.
cues: Describe today's weather
Say what you do if it rains
a2-65-consolidation.target: Ma felhős és szeles az idő. Ha esik az eső, otthon maradunk.
a2-65-consolidation.english: Today the weather is cloudy and windy. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
a2-65-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the weather in detail — sun, wind, clouds, rain and snow.

a2-66.title: Communicative Challenge: By Bus to the Station
a2-66.scenario: Károly cannot come with Meg to the station next weekend and asks how she will get there. You (Meg) go by bus, and you get off at the next stop.
a2-66.prompt: Tell Károly that you are going to the station by bus and that you get off at the next stop.
cues: Say how you travel to the station
Say where you get off
a2-66.target: Busszal megyek a pályaudvarra. A következő megállónál leszállok.
a2-66.english: I'm going to the station by bus. I get off at the next stop.
a2-66.canDo: I can talk about buses, trams and the metro.

a2-67.title: Communicative Challenge: A Pass, Please
a2-67.scenario: At the ticket machine Meg wants to buy a pass for the trip. You (Meg) ask for a pass, ask the price, and ask whether it is valid for a month.
a2-67.prompt: Ask for a pass, ask how much it costs, and ask if it is valid for a month.
cues: Ask for a pass
Ask the price
Ask whether it is valid for a month
a2-67.target: Egy bérletet kérek. Mennyibe kerül? Egy hónapra érvényes?
a2-67.english: I'd like a pass. How much does it cost? Is it valid for a month?
a2-67.canDo: I can buy a ticket or a pass.

a2-68.title: Communicative Challenge: When Does It Leave?
a2-68.scenario: Meg checks the timetable before leaving. You ask when the bus leaves, and when it arrives at the station.
a2-68.prompt: Ask when the bus leaves and when it arrives at the station.
cues: Ask when the bus leaves
Ask when it arrives at the station
a2-68.target: Mikor indul a busz? Mikor érkezik a pályaudvarra?
a2-68.english: When does the bus leave? When does it arrive at the station?
a2-68.canDo: I can ask when a bus or tram departs and arrives.

a2-69.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Number?
a2-69.scenario: Meg is planning her route to the station and asks Károly which bus number to take. Then you tell him that you transfer to tram number 4 at Blaha Lujza Square.
a2-69.prompt: Ask Károly which-numbered bus you take, and tell him that you transfer to tram number 4 at Blaha Lujza Square.
cues: Ask which number bus to take
Say where you transfer and onto which tram
a2-69.target: Hányas busszal megyek? A Blaha Lujza térnél átszállok a négyes villamosra.
a2-69.english: Which bus number do I take? At Blaha Lujza Square I transfer onto tram number 4.
a2-69.canDo: I can talk about changing lines.

a2-70.title: Communicative Challenge: How Do I Get There?
a2-70.scenario: Meg is going to Nyugati station alone and asks Károly for the way. You ask how to get there, and tell him your plan: first by bus, then you change to a tram.
a2-70.prompt: Ask Károly how you get to Nyugati station, and tell him your plan: first by bus, then you transfer to a tram.
cues: Ask how to get to the station
Describe your plan in order: bus, then tram
a2-70.target: Hogyan jutok el a Nyugati pályaudvarra? Előbb busszal megyek, aztán átszállok villamosra.
a2-70.english: How do I get to Nyugati station? First I go by bus, then I transfer to a tram.
a2-70.canDo: I can ask how to get to a place by public transport.

a2-70-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Ticket and Timetable
a2-70-consolidation.scenario: Meg arrives at the bus stop. You (Meg) ask for a ticket and ask when the bus leaves for Nyugati station.
a2-70-consolidation.prompt: Ask for a ticket, and ask when the bus leaves for Nyugati station.
cues: Ask for a ticket
Ask when the bus leaves for the station
a2-70-consolidation.target: Egy jegyet kérek. Mikor indul a busz a Nyugati pályaudvarra?
a2-70-consolidation.english: One ticket, please. When does the bus leave for Nyugati station?
a2-70-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about buses, trams and the metro, and say how I travel using -val/-vel.

a2-71.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning the Trip
a2-71.scenario: A few weeks earlier Károly suggested a trip to Szeged. He asks Meg about the plan. You (Meg) say that you are travelling to Szeged in two weeks and staying for two weeks.
a2-71.prompt: Tell Károly when you are travelling to Szeged and for how long you are staying.
cues: Say when you travel to Szeged
Say how long you stay
a2-71.target: Két hét múlva Szegedre utazunk. Két hétig maradunk.
a2-71.english: In two weeks we're travelling to Szeged. We're staying for two weeks.
a2-71.canDo: I can talk about my travel plans for the near future.

a2-72.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Platform?
a2-72.scenario: At the station Meg wants to take the train to Szeged. You ask when the train to Szeged leaves and which platform it leaves from.
a2-72.prompt: Ask when the train to Szeged leaves and which platform it leaves from.
cues: Ask when the train leaves
Ask which platform it leaves from
a2-72.target: Mikor indul a vonat Szegedre? Melyik vágányról indul?
a2-72.english: When does the train to Szeged leave? Which platform does it leave from?
a2-72.canDo: I can ask when and from where a train departs and arrives.

a2-73.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Airport
a2-73.scenario: Károly asks Meg what you have to do at the airport. You (Meg) say that you have to check in, and at the gate you have to show your passport and boarding pass.
a2-73.prompt: Tell Károly what you have to do at the airport and at the gate.
cues: Say what you have to do at the airport
Say what you have to show at the gate
a2-73.target: A repülőtéren be kell csekkolni. A kapunál meg kell mutatni az útlevelet és a beszállókártyát.
a2-73.english: At the airport you have to check in. At the gate you have to show your passport and boarding pass.
a2-73.canDo: I can name the key things and places at an airport.

a2-74.title: Communicative Challenge: A Problem on the Way
a2-74.scenario: Meg phones Károly from the station: there is a problem with the train to Szeged. You tell him that the train is late, and that if it is late you will wait.
a2-74.prompt: Tell Károly that you have a problem, that the train is late, and what you do if it is late.
cues: Say you have a problem: the train is late
Say that if it is late you wait
a2-74.target: Van egy problémánk: késik a vonat. Ha késik a vonat, akkor várunk.
a2-74.english: We have a problem: the train is late. If the train is late, then we wait.
a2-74.canDo: I can describe a common travel problem.

a2-75.title: Communicative Challenge: Why I Love Trains
a2-75.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she likes and hates about travelling. You (Meg) love travelling by train because it is fast, and you hate getting up early.
a2-75.prompt: Tell Károly that you love travelling by train and why, and what you hate.
cues: Say you love travelling by train and give a reason
Say what you hate
a2-75.target: Imádok vonattal utazni, mert gyors. Utálok korán kelni.
a2-75.english: I love travelling by train, because it's fast. I hate getting up early.
a2-75.canDo: I can say what I like and hate about traveling.

a2-75-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Szeged Trip
a2-75-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the trip to Szeged. In two weeks you are going for two weeks, and you love travelling by train because it is fast.
a2-75-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly when you are travelling to Szeged and for how long, and why you like the train.
cues: Say when you travel and for how long
Say you love the train and give a reason
a2-75-consolidation.target: Két hét múlva Szegedre utazunk, két hétig maradunk. Imádok vonattal utazni, mert gyors.
a2-75-consolidation.english: In two weeks we're travelling to Szeged, we're staying for two weeks. I love travelling by train, because it's fast.
a2-75-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about my travel plans and say how long I'm going somewhere for.

a2-76.title: Communicative Challenge: Booking a Room
a2-76.scenario: Meg phones a hotel in Szeged to book a room for the trip with Károly. You (Meg) want a double room for two nights, and want to know which room is the cheapest.
a2-76.prompt: Tell the receptionist that you would like to book a double room for two nights, and ask which room is the cheapest.
cues: Say what kind of room and for how many nights
Ask which room is the cheapest
a2-76.target: Szeretnék foglalni egy kétágyas szobát két éjszakára. Melyik a legolcsóbb szoba?
a2-76.english: I'd like to book a double room for two nights. Which is the cheapest room?
a2-76.canDo: I can ask about room types and say how many nights I want to stay.

a2-77.title: Communicative Challenge: Checking In
a2-77.scenario: Meg and Károly arrive at the hotel in Szeged and go to reception. You (Meg) say you are checking in, ask for the key, and ask what floor your room is on.
a2-77.prompt: Tell the receptionist you are checking in, ask for the key, and ask what floor your room is on.
cues: Say you are checking in
Ask for the key
Ask which floor the room is on
a2-77.target: Bejelentkezünk. Kérem a kulcsot. Hányadik emeleten van a szobánk?
a2-77.english: We're checking in. The key, please. What floor is our room on?
a2-77.canDo: I can check in and get my key at reception.

a2-78.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is in the Room?
a2-78.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the hotel room has. You (Meg) say there is a double bed, air conditioning and a minibar, and a lot of pillows and blankets.
a2-78.prompt: Tell Károly what is in the hotel room.
cues: Say what furniture and equipment the room has
Say there are a lot of pillows and blankets
a2-78.target: A szobában van franciaágy, klíma és minibár. Van sok párna és takaró is.
a2-78.english: In the room there is a double bed, air conditioning and a minibar. There are a lot of pillows and blankets too.
a2-78.canDo: I can describe what's in my hotel room.

a2-79.title: Communicative Challenge: The Air Conditioning Doesn't Work
a2-79.scenario: Meg goes down to reception because something is wrong in the hotel room. The air conditioning doesn't work.
a2-79.prompt: Tell the receptionist that the air conditioning doesn't work, and ask for a different room.
cues: Report what doesn't work
Ask for a different room
a2-79.target: Nem működik a klíma. Kérek egy másik szobát.
a2-79.english: The air conditioning doesn't work. I'd like a different room.
a2-79.canDo: I can report that something in my room doesn't work.

a2-80.title: Communicative Challenge: Checking Out
a2-80.scenario: The next morning Meg and Károly check out. You (Meg) say you are checking out and would like to pay by card, and that you are very satisfied with the room.
a2-80.prompt: Tell the receptionist that you are checking out, that you'd like to pay by card, and that you are very satisfied with the room.
cues: Say you are checking out and how you want to pay
Say you are satisfied with the room
a2-80.target: Kijelentkezünk, és kártyával szeretnék fizetni. Nagyon elégedett vagyok a szobával.
a2-80.english: We're checking out, and I'd like to pay by card. I'm very satisfied with the room.
a2-80.canDo: I can check out and say how I'd like to pay.

a2-80-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Problem and a Payment
a2-80-consolidation.scenario: At the hotel in Szeged Meg talks to the receptionist. The air conditioning doesn't work, so you ask for a different room, and say how you'd like to pay.
a2-80-consolidation.prompt: Report the problem, ask for a different room, and say you'd like to pay by card.
cues: Report what doesn't work and ask for another room
Say how you'd like to pay
a2-80-consolidation.target: Nem működik a klíma. Kérek egy másik szobát, és kártyával szeretnék fizetni.
a2-80-consolidation.english: The air conditioning doesn't work. I'd like a different room, and I'd like to pay by card.
a2-80-consolidation.canDo: I can book a hotel room, check in, and find my way to it.

a2-81.title: Communicative Challenge: What Hurts?
a2-81.scenario: On the train home from Szeged Meg does not feel well. Károly asks what hurts. Your head, your eyes and your ears hurt.
a2-81.prompt: Tell Károly which parts of your body hurt: your head, your eyes and your ears.
cues: Name three body parts that hurt
a2-81.target: Fáj a fejem, a szemem és a fülem.
a2-81.english: My head, my eyes and my ears hurt.
a2-81.canDo: I can name the main parts of the body.

a2-82.title: Communicative Challenge: I Don't Feel Well
a2-82.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she is feeling on the train. You (Meg) feel unwell, you have a fever and you are coughing.
a2-82.prompt: Tell Károly that you feel unwell, that you have a fever and that you are coughing.
cues: Say how you feel
Say you have a fever and a cough
a2-82.target: Rosszul érzem magam. Lázam van, és köhögök.
a2-82.english: I feel unwell. I have a fever, and I'm coughing.
a2-82.canDo: I can say how I'm feeling, well or unwell.

a2-83.title: Communicative Challenge: What's Wrong?
a2-83.scenario: On the train Károly looks pale. You (Meg) ask him what is wrong, where exactly it hurts, and since when.
a2-83.prompt: Ask Károly what is wrong, where exactly it hurts, and since when.
cues: Ask what is wrong
Ask where it hurts
Ask since when
a2-83.target: Mi a baj? Hol fáj pontosan? Mióta fáj?
a2-83.english: What's wrong? Where exactly does it hurt? Since when has it hurt?
a2-83.canDo: I can ask someone what's wrong and where it hurts.

a2-84.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Doctor's
a2-84.scenario: Back in Budapest, Meg goes to the doctor's surgery. The doctor asks, in formal speech, what the matter is. You (Meg) say that your throat has hurt for two days and that you have a fever.
a2-84.prompt: Tell the doctor that your throat has hurt for two days and that you have a fever.
cues: Say how long your throat has hurt
Say you have a fever
a2-84.target: Két napja fáj a torkom, és lázam van.
a2-84.english: My throat has hurt for two days, and I have a fever.
a2-84.canDo: I can describe my symptoms formally to a doctor.

a2-85.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pharmacy
a2-85.scenario: Meg and Károly stop at a pharmacy near the station. The pharmacist asks how she can help. Your throat hurts and you have a fever.
a2-85.prompt: Tell the pharmacist what hurts and ask whether there is something for a fever.
cues: Say your throat hurts and you have a fever
Ask for something for the fever
a2-85.target: Fáj a torkom, és lázam van. Van valami láz ellen?
a2-85.english: My throat hurts, and I have a fever. Is there something for a fever?
a2-85.canDo: I can ask for something for a specific ailment at the pharmacy.

a2-85-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Feeling Ill
a2-85-consolidation.scenario: Meg is at the pharmacy. The pharmacist asks what is wrong. You feel unwell, your throat has hurt for two days, and you want something for the fever.
a2-85-consolidation.prompt: Tell the pharmacist how you feel, how long your throat has hurt, and ask for something for a fever.
cues: Say how you feel
Say how long your throat has hurt
Ask for something for a fever
a2-85-consolidation.target: Rosszul érzem magam. Két napja fáj a torkom. Van valami láz ellen?
a2-85-consolidation.english: I feel unwell. My throat has hurt for two days. Is there something for a fever?
a2-85-consolidation.canDo: I can name the main parts of the body and say what hurts.

a2-86.title: Communicative Challenge: Healthy Habits?
a2-86.scenario: A week after her sore throat Meg feels well but tired, and Károly asks about her habits. You (Meg) exercise little, don't sleep enough, but you eat a lot of fruit.
a2-86.prompt: Tell Károly that you exercise little and don't sleep enough, and that you eat a lot of fruit.
cues: Say how much you exercise and sleep
Say what you eat a lot of
a2-86.target: Keveset mozgok, és nem alszom eleget. Sok gyümölcsöt eszem.
a2-86.english: I don't exercise much, and I don't sleep enough. I eat a lot of fruit.
a2-86.canDo: I can describe healthy and unhealthy habits.

a2-87.title: Communicative Challenge: What Should I Do?
a2-87.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she is tired. You (Meg) say that you should rest more, and you ask him what you should do.
a2-87.prompt: Tell Károly that you should rest more, and ask him what you should do.
cues: Say what you should do
Ask what you should do
a2-87.english: I should rest more. What should I do?
a2-87.canDo: I can say what someone should do using kellene.

a2-88.title: Communicative Challenge: Instead of Sugar
a2-88.scenario: Meg and Károly talk about healthy living. You (Meg) eat fruit instead of sugar, and advise Károly to exercise regularly too.
a2-88.prompt: Tell Károly that you eat fruit instead of sugar, and advise him to exercise regularly.
cues: Say what you eat instead of sugar
Advise him to exercise regularly
a2-88.target: Cukor helyett gyümölcsöt eszem. Azt tanácsolom, hogy te is mozogj rendszeresen.
a2-88.english: I eat fruit instead of sugar. I advise you to exercise regularly too.
a2-88.canDo: I can say I do one thing instead of another using helyett.

a2-89.title: Communicative Challenge: I Can't, It's Not Allowed
a2-89.scenario: Károly suggests that Meg exercises in the park in the evening. You (Meg) say that you can't sleep because your head hurts, and that in the evening you can no longer exercise in the park.
a2-89.prompt: Tell Károly that you can't sleep because your head hurts, and that in the evening you can't exercise in the park any more.
cues: Say what you can't do and why
Say what is no longer possible in the evening
a2-89.target: Nem tudok aludni, mert fáj a fejem. Este már nem lehet sportolni a parkban.
a2-89.english: I can't sleep because my head hurts. In the evening you can no longer exercise in the park.
a2-89.canDo: I can say what I am and am not able to do using tud.

a2-90.title: Communicative Challenge: From Now On
a2-90.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she has decided. You (Meg) say that fruit is healthier than chocolate, and that from now on you live more healthily.
a2-90.prompt: Tell Károly that fruit is healthier than chocolate, and that from now on you live more healthily.
cues: Compare fruit and chocolate
Say what you do from now on
a2-90.target: A gyümölcs egészségesebb, mint a csoki. Mostantól egészségesebben élek.
a2-90.english: Fruit is healthier than chocolate. From now on I live more healthily.
a2-90.canDo: I can compare habits using jobb, rosszabb and egészségesebb.

a2-90-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Healthier Me
a2-90-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she plans to feel less tired. You (Meg) don't sleep enough, you should sleep more, and from now on you sleep better.
a2-90-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that you don't sleep enough, that you should sleep more, and that from now on you sleep better.
cues: Say you don't sleep enough
Say what you should do
Say what you do from now on
a2-90-consolidation.target: Nem alszom eleget. Kellene többet aludni. Mostantól jobban alszom.
a2-90-consolidation.english: I don't sleep enough. I should sleep more. From now on I sleep better.
a2-90-consolidation.canDo: I can describe healthy and unhealthy habits and say how much I exercise and sleep.

a2-91.title: Communicative Challenge: My Sister at University
a2-91.scenario: Meg is looking through her old notebook with Károly. He asks about her younger sister. She is a student, has been going to university since September, and has an exam tomorrow.
a2-91.prompt: Tell Károly that your sister is a student who has been going to university since September, and that she has an exam tomorrow.
cues: Say she is a student and since when she attends university
Say she has an exam tomorrow
a2-91.target: A húgom diák, szeptember óta egyetemre jár. Holnap vizsgája van.
a2-91.english: My younger sister is a student, she has been going to university since September. Tomorrow she has an exam.
a2-91.canDo: I can talk about school and university life using words like tanár, diák, and vizsga.

a2-92.title: Communicative Challenge: Good at Literature
a2-92.scenario: Looking at the old notebook, Károly asks Meg which school subjects she was good at. You (Meg) say what you are good and bad at, and that you are studying history for the exam tonight.
a2-92.prompt: Tell Károly which subject you are good at and which you are bad at, and that you are studying history tonight.
cues: Say what you are good at and bad at
Say you are studying the history material tonight
a2-92.target: Jó vagyok irodalomban, de rossz vagyok matematikában. Ma este tanulom a történelmet.
a2-92.english: I'm good at literature, but I'm bad at maths. Tonight I'm studying the history material.
a2-92.canDo: I can name school subjects and say which ones I'm good or bad at.

a2-93.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Languages?
a2-93.scenario: Károly asks Meg which languages she knows. You (Meg) know English and German, and you know Hungarian too, but you can't speak it well yet.
a2-93.prompt: Tell Károly which languages you know, and that you know Hungarian but can't speak it well.
cues: Say which languages you know
Say you know Hungarian but cannot speak it well
a2-93.target: Tudok angolul és németül. Magyarul is tudok, de nem tudok jól beszélni.
a2-93.english: I know English and German. I know Hungarian too, but I can't speak well.
a2-93.canDo: I can say what languages I speak, using the correct -ul/-ül form.

a2-94.title: Communicative Challenge: How I Learn
a2-94.scenario: Károly asks how Meg learns Hungarian. You (Meg) have a hard time memorizing the grammar, and you learn pronunciation by listening and repeating.
a2-94.prompt: Tell Károly what you find hard to memorize, and how you learn pronunciation.
cues: Say what you have a hard time memorizing
Say how you learn pronunciation
a2-94.target: Nehezen jegyzem meg a nyelvtant. Hallgatással és ismétléssel tanulom a kiejtést.
a2-94.english: I have a hard time memorizing the grammar. I learn pronunciation by listening and repeating.
a2-94.canDo: I can describe how I learn, quickly or slowly, easily or with difficulty.

a2-95.title: Communicative Challenge: My Goals
a2-95.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her goals for Hungarian. You (Meg) will speak Hungarian fluently next year, and your goal is to practise every day.
a2-95.prompt: Tell Károly that next year you will speak Hungarian fluently, and that your goal is to practise every day.
cues: Say what you will do next year
Say what your goal is
a2-95.target: Jövőre folyékonyan beszélek magyarul. A célom az, hogy minden nap gyakoroljak.
a2-95.english: Next year I'll speak Hungarian fluently. My goal is to practise every day.
a2-95.canDo: I can talk about my language-learning plans using the present tense with a future time word.

a2-95-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian and Me
a2-95-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her Hungarian. You (Meg) say that you are good at literature, that you know Hungarian, and that you hope to speak it fluently next year.
a2-95-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what you are good at, that you know Hungarian, and that you hope to speak it fluently next year.
cues: Say what subject you are good at
Say you know Hungarian
Say what you hope for next year
a2-95-consolidation.target: Jó vagyok irodalomban. Tudok magyarul, és remélem, hogy jövőre folyékonyan beszélek.
a2-95-consolidation.english: I'm good at literature. I know Hungarian, and I hope that next year I'll speak fluently.
a2-95-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about school and university life, and say where I study and since when.

a2-96.title: Communicative Challenge: Hobbies at Sunday Lunch
a2-96.scenario: At Sunday lunch at Gábor and Ildikó's, Petra asks Meg about her hobbies. You (Meg) like taking photographs in your free time, and you go running at the weekend.
a2-96.prompt: Tell Petra what you like doing in your free time and what you do at weekends.
cues: Say what hobby you like
Say what sport you do at weekends
a2-96.target: Szabadidőmben szeretek fényképezni. Hétvégente futni járok.
a2-96.english: In my free time I like taking photographs. At weekends I go running.
a2-96.canDo: I can talk about my hobbies, sports and how often I do them.

a2-97.title: Communicative Challenge: If It Rains
a2-97.scenario: Gábor looks out of the window at the grey sky and asks Meg how she will get to the station. You (Meg) say that if it rains you go by bus, and that you get on the number 7.
a2-97.prompt: Tell Gábor how you get to the station if it rains.
cues: Say what you do if it rains
Say which bus you get on
a2-97.target: Ha esik az eső, busszal megyek. Felszállok a hetes buszra.
a2-97.english: If it rains, I go by bus. I get on the number 7 bus.
a2-97.canDo: I can describe the weather and the seasons, and make weather-based plans.

a2-98.title: Communicative Challenge: Booking a Trip
a2-98.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg and Károly about their next trip. You (Meg) say that in two weeks you are travelling to Szeged and that you would like to book a double room for two nights.
a2-98.prompt: Tell Ildikó when you are travelling to Szeged and what room you would like to book.
cues: Say when you travel to Szeged
Say what room you would like to book and for how long
a2-98.target: Két hét múlva Szegedre utazunk. Szeretnék foglalni egy kétágyas szobát két éjszakára.
a2-98.english: In two weeks we're travelling to Szeged. I'd like to book a double room for two nights.
a2-98.canDo: I can plan a trip, deal with travel problems, and talk about my travel experiences.

a2-99.title: Communicative Challenge: Still Not Well
a2-99.scenario: Ildikó notices that Meg looks tired and asks what is wrong. Your throat has hurt for two days and you have a fever; you think you should rest more.
a2-99.prompt: Tell Ildikó what is wrong with you and how long it has lasted, and say what you should do.
cues: Say what hurts and how long
Say you have a fever
Say what you should do
a2-99.target: Két napja fáj a torkom, és lázam van. Kellene többet pihenni.
a2-99.english: My throat has hurt for two days, and I have a fever. I should rest more.
a2-99.canDo: I can describe symptoms, say what hurts, and talk to a doctor or pharmacist.

a2-100.title: Communicative Challenge: My Hungarian Goal
a2-100.scenario: Petra asks Meg how her Hungarian is going. You (Meg) have been learning Hungarian since September, and your goal is to speak it fluently next year.
a2-100.prompt: Tell Petra since when you have been learning Hungarian and what your goal is.
cues: Say since when you have been learning Hungarian
Say what your goal is for next year
a2-100.target: Szeptember óta tanulok magyarul. A célom az, hogy jövőre folyékonyan beszéljek.
a2-100.english: I've been learning Hungarian since September. My goal is to speak fluently next year.
a2-100.canDo: I can talk about school, university and my language-learning progress.

a2-100-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekend Plans at Lunch
a2-100-consolidation.scenario: Over Sunday lunch Gábor asks Meg about her weekends. You (Meg) photograph something in the city every weekend, but if it rains you stay at home.
a2-100-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gábor what you do at weekends and what you do if it rains.
cues: Say what you do at weekends
Say what you do if it rains
a2-100-consolidation.target: Hétvégente fényképezek valamit a városban. Ha esik az eső, otthon maradok.
a2-100-consolidation.english: At weekends I photograph something in the city. If it rains, I stay at home.
a2-100-consolidation.canDo: I can use the main vocabulary and grammar from Units 11-19.

a2-101.title: Communicative Challenge: What Do You Do?
a2-101.scenario: Meg is at a company for an interview, and Petra, whom she knows, is at the reception desk. Petra asks what Meg does. You (Meg) are an engineer, and Károly is a doctor.
a2-101.prompt: Tell Petra your profession and Károly's profession.
cues: Say what your profession is
Say what Károly's profession is
a2-101.english: I'm an engineer. Károly is a doctor.
a2-101.canDo: I can name common professions in Hungarian, like tanár, orvos, and mérnök.

a2-102.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Do You Work?
a2-102.scenario: At the company reception Petra asks Meg where she works and who she works for. You (Meg) work in an office, for a big company.
a2-102.prompt: Tell Petra where you work and who you work for.
cues: Say where you work
Say what kind of employer you work for
a2-102.target: Egy irodában dolgozom, egy nagy cégnél.
a2-102.english: I work in an office, for a big company.
a2-102.canDo: I can say where I work using egy irodában, egy boltban, and similar phrases.

a2-103.title: Communicative Challenge: Working Hours
a2-103.scenario: Petra asks Meg about her working hours. Your working hours start at nine in the morning and end at five in the afternoon, so you work eight hours a day.
a2-103.prompt: Tell Petra when your working hours start and end, and how many hours you work.
cues: Say when your working hours start
Say when they end
Say how many hours you work
a2-103.target: A munkaidőm reggel kilenckor kezdődik, és délután ötkor végződik. Nyolc órát dolgozom.
a2-103.english: My working hours start at nine in the morning, and end at five in the afternoon. I work eight hours.
a2-103.canDo: I can say when my working hours start and end using kezdődik and végződik.

a2-104.title: Communicative Challenge: Meet My Colleague
a2-104.scenario: After the interview Károly comes to meet Meg at the company. You (Meg) introduce your colleague Petra to him and say that she is very helpful.
a2-104.prompt: Introduce your colleague Petra to Károly, and say that she is very helpful.
cues: Introduce your colleague
Say she is helpful
a2-104.target: Bemutatom a munkatársamat, Petrát. Nagyon segítőkész.
a2-104.english: Let me introduce my colleague, Petra. She's very helpful.
a2-104.canDo: I can talk about my coworkers using possessive suffixes, like a munkatársam and a főnököm.

a2-105.title: Communicative Challenge: Tasks Today
