a2-206.prompt: Greet the clerk, say that you would like to post a letter abroad, and ask how much a stamp to Germany costs.
cues: Greet the clerk politely
Say you would like to post a letter abroad
Ask the price of a stamp to Germany
a2-206.target: Jó napot kívánok! Szeretnék feladni egy levelet külföldre. Mennyibe kerül a bélyeg Németországba?
a2-206.english: Good day! I would like to post a letter abroad. How much is a stamp to Germany?
a2-206.canDo: I can navigate a Hungarian post office, take a queue number, and interact politely at counter windows.

a2-207.title: Communicative Challenge: Registered Mail
a2-207.scenario: Péter has an important official letter. At window three the clerk asks him how he wants to send it.
a2-207.prompt: Tell the clerk that you would like to send this official letter registered and with a return receipt, and ask for a dispatch receipt.
cues: Say how you want to send the letter
Ask for the return receipt
Ask for a dispatch receipt
a2-207.target: Ezt a hivatalos levelet ajánlottan és tértivevénnyel szeretném feladni. Kérek egy feladóvevényt.
a2-207.english: I would like to send this official letter registered and with a return receipt. I would like a dispatch receipt.
a2-207.canDo: I can post registered letters (ajánlott levél) and request return receipts (tértivevény).

a2-208.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Yellow Cheques
a2-208.scenario: Péter has two yellow cheques, one for the gas bill and one for the electricity bill. At the counter the clerk asks what he would like to pay.
a2-208.prompt: Say that you would like to pay in the two yellow cheques and ask whether you can pay by bank card.
cues: Say you want to pay in the two cheques
Ask if you can pay by bank card
a2-208.target: Két sárga csekket szeretnék befizetni. Bankkártyával fizethetek?
a2-208.english: I would like to pay in two yellow cheques. Can I pay by bank card?
a2-208.canDo: I can pay utility bills using the iconic Hungarian yellow cheque (sárga csekk).

a2-209.title: Communicative Challenge: The Parcel Locker
a2-209.scenario: Péter got an SMS with an opening code for the parcel locker on the corner, but he has never used one. At the post office he asks the clerk for help.
a2-209.prompt: Tell the clerk that you got an SMS with the opening code and ask how pickup at the parcel locker works.
cues: Say you got an SMS with the opening code
Ask how the pickup works
a2-209.target: Kaptam egy SMS-t a nyitókóddal. Hogy működik az átvétel a csomagautomatánál?
a2-209.english: I got an SMS with the opening code. How does the pickup at the parcel locker work?
a2-209.canDo: I can collect and send packages using modern Hungarian parcel lockers (Foxpost, MPL, GLS).

a2-210.title: Communicative Challenge: The Collection Notice
a2-210.scenario: The postman left a notice in Péter's mailbox because he was not at home. Péter goes to the post office, and the clerk asks why he has come.
a2-210.prompt: Say that the postman left a notice in your mailbox, and tell the clerk that here are the notice and your identity card.
cues: Say the postman left a notice in your mailbox
Say here are the notice and your identity card
a2-210.target: A postás értesítőt hagyott a postaládámban. Itt van az értesítő és a személyi igazolványom.
a2-210.english: The postman left a notice in my mailbox. Here are the notice and my identity card.
a2-210.canDo: I can collect parcels and registered letters using official collection notices (értesítő) and ID verification.

a2-210-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Letter and Cheque
a2-210-consolidation.scenario: Péter is at the post office with an official letter and a yellow cheque. The clerk at window three asks what he would like to do.
a2-210-consolidation.prompt: Say that you are sending an official letter and want to send it registered, and ask whether you can pay the cheque by card.
cues: Say you are sending an official letter
Say you want it registered
Ask if you can pay the cheque by card
a2-210-consolidation.target: Hivatalos levelet küldök, ezért ajánlottan adom fel. Lehet kártyával fizetni a csekket?
a2-210-consolidation.english: I am sending an official letter, so I am posting it registered. Can I pay the cheque by card?
a2-210-consolidation.canDo: I can queue, send registered mail, pay a yellow cheque and collect a parcel at a Hungarian post office.

a2-211.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Account
a2-211.scenario: Gábor has started a new job and needs a Hungarian bank account. At the Deák Ferenc tér branch the clerk calls him to desk two and asks how she can help.
a2-211.prompt: Greet the clerk, say that you would like to open a new current account, and hand over your identity card and address card.
cues: Greet the clerk
Say you would like to open a current account
Say here are your identity card and address card
a2-211.target: Jó napot kívánok! Szeretnék új folyószámlát nyitni. Itt van a személyi igazolványom és a lakcímkártyám.
a2-211.english: Good day! I would like to open a new current account. Here are my identity card and my address card.
a2-211.canDo: I can open a current account at a Hungarian bank and communicate at customer desks.

a2-212.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Cash Machine
a2-212.scenario: Eszter and Gábor are at the ATM in front of the bank. Eszter asks Gábor what he is doing at the machine.
a2-212.prompt: Tell Eszter that you would like to withdraw twenty thousand forints from the machine and that you first have to key in your PIN code.
cues: Say you want to withdraw twenty thousand forints
Say you first have to key in your PIN code
a2-212.target: Szeretnék húszezer forintot felvenni az automatából. Előbb be kell ütnöm a PIN-kódot.
a2-212.english: I would like to withdraw twenty thousand forints from the machine. First I have to key in the PIN code.
a2-212.canDo: I can use an ATM in Hungary for cash withdrawals, balance inquiries, and language selection.

a2-213.title: Communicative Challenge: Card or Cash
a2-213.scenario: Eszter and Gábor have finished lunch in a restaurant. Gábor is treating Eszter, and she asks him how he wants to pay.
a2-213.prompt: Tell Eszter that you would like to pay by card, contactless if possible, and that you do not want a VAT invoice.
cues: Say you want to pay by card
Say contactless if possible
Say you do not want a VAT invoice
a2-213.target: Kártyával szeretnék fizetni, ha lehet érintéssel. Nem kérek áfás számlát.
a2-213.english: I would like to pay by card, contactless if possible. I do not want a VAT invoice.
a2-213.canDo: I can handle cash and card payments at checkouts, restaurants, and shops across Hungary.

a2-214.title: Communicative Challenge: Paying Eszter Back
a2-214.scenario: Eszter bought the concert tickets last night. Now she asks Gábor to send her his share of the price.
a2-214.prompt: Tell Eszter that you will transfer the amount to her bank account this evening and ask what to write in the reference field.
cues: Say you will transfer the amount tonight
Say it goes to her bank account
Ask what to write in the reference field
a2-214.target: Este átutalom neked az összeget a bankszámládra. Mit írjak a közlemény rovatba?
a2-214.english: This evening I will transfer the amount to your bank account. What should I write in the reference field?
a2-214.canDo: I can initiate domestic bank transfers in Hungary (beneficiary, account number, reference memo).

a2-215.title: Communicative Challenge: A Lost Card
a2-215.scenario: On the tram Gábor finds that his bank card is gone. He calls the bank, and the clerk at the 24-hour line asks what has happened.
a2-215.prompt: Tell the clerk that you lost your bank card on the tram and that you would like to block it at once.
cues: Say you lost your bank card
Say where you lost it
Say you want to block it at once
a2-215.target: Elhagytam a bankkártyámat a villamoson. Szeretném azonnal letiltani.
a2-215.english: I lost my bank card on the tram. I would like to block it at once.
a2-215.canDo: I can handle banking emergencies: card freezing (letiltás), reporting lost cards, and disputing transactions.

a2-215-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Back at the Branch
a2-215-consolidation.scenario: Gábor is back at the Deák Ferenc tér branch. The clerk at the desk asks him what he needs today.
a2-215-consolidation.prompt: Tell the clerk that you would like to open a new current account and that you will approve transfers in mobile banking.
cues: Say you want to open a new current account
Say you will approve transfers in mobile banking
a2-215-consolidation.target: Új folyószámlát szeretnék nyitni a bankfiókban. Az átutalást a mobilbankban hagyom jóvá.
a2-215-consolidation.english: I would like to open a new current account in the bank branch. I approve the transfer in mobile banking.
a2-215-consolidation.canDo: I can open an account, use an ATM, pay by card or in cash and make a bank transfer in Hungarian.

a2-216.title: Communicative Challenge: A Sore Throat
a2-216.scenario: Zoltán has a sore throat and a cough. He goes into the pharmacy, and the pharmacist asks what is wrong.
a2-216.prompt: Greet the pharmacist, say that your throat hurts badly, and ask whether she can recommend something for a cold.
cues: Greet the pharmacist
Say your throat hurts badly
Ask her to recommend something for a cold
a2-216.target: Jó napot kívánok! Nagyon fáj a torkom. Tudna ajánlani valamit megfázásra?
a2-216.english: Good day! My throat hurts badly. Could you recommend something for a cold?
a2-216.canDo: I can describe common acute symptoms at a Hungarian pharmacy (sore throat, cough, fever, runny nose).

a2-217.title: Communicative Challenge: The Prescription in the Cloud
a2-217.scenario: At the night pharmacy window the pharmacist asks Zoltán whether he has a paper prescription or whether it is in the cloud.
a2-217.prompt: Tell the pharmacist that the doctor put the prescription into the cloud, that here is your TAJ card, and that you would like to collect the medicines.
cues: Say the doctor put the prescription into the cloud
Say here is your TAJ card
Say you would like to collect the medicines
a2-217.target: Az orvos felírta a receptet a felhőbe. Itt van a TAJ-kártyám, és szeretném kiváltani a gyógyszereimet.
a2-217.english: The doctor put the prescription into the cloud. Here is my TAJ card, and I would like to collect my medicines.
a2-217.canDo: I can navigate prescription-only (vényköteles) and over-the-counter (vény nélküli) medications in Hungary.

a2-218.title: Communicative Challenge: How Do I Take It?
a2-218.scenario: Zoltán has the antibiotic in his hand and is not sure how to take it. He asks the pharmacist at the window.
a2-218.prompt: Ask the pharmacist how you have to take this antibiotic, and ask whether you can drive after taking it.
cues: Ask how to take the antibiotic
Ask whether you can drive after taking it
a2-218.target: Hogyan kell szednem ezt az antibiotikumot? Vezethetek autót, ha beveszem a gyógyszert?
a2-218.english: How do I have to take this antibiotic? Can I drive if I take the medicine?
a2-218.canDo: I can comprehend medical dosage instructions (étkezés előtt/után, éhgyomorra, naponta kétszer).

a2-219.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Out-of-Hours Clinic
a2-219.scenario: It is Saturday night. Zoltán and Kata have arrived at the out-of-hours clinic, and the on-call doctor asks Zoltán what the main problem is.
a2-219.prompt: Tell the doctor that you suddenly got a high fever at night and that your throat hurts badly.
cues: Say you suddenly got a high fever at night
Say your throat hurts badly
a2-219.target: Éjszaka hirtelen magas láz tört ki. Nagyon fáj a torkom.
a2-219.english: A high fever suddenly broke out at night. My throat hurts badly.
a2-219.canDo: I can navigate out-of-hours urgent medical care (ügyelet, 1830) and night duty pharmacies in Hungary.

a2-220.title: Communicative Challenge: Off Sick
a2-220.scenario: It is Monday and Zoltán still has a fever. Kata, who works with him, phones to ask why he is not at work.
a2-220.prompt: Tell Kata that the GP has put you on sick leave and that you have to stay at home until Friday.
cues: Say the GP put you on sick leave
Say you have to stay at home until Friday
a2-220.target: A háziorvos kiírt betegszabadságra, péntekig otthon kell maradnom.
a2-220.english: The GP has put me on sick leave, I have to stay at home until Friday.
a2-220.canDo: I can handle sick leave (betegszabadság), medical certificates (orvosi igazolás), and workplace illness reporting.

a2-220-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Night Window
a2-220-consolidation.scenario: Zoltán is at the window of the night pharmacy. The pharmacist asks what he needs.
a2-220-consolidation.prompt: Tell the pharmacist that your throat hurts and you cough, that the doctor put a prescription into the cloud, and that you would like to collect it.
cues: Say your throat hurts and you cough
Say the doctor put a prescription into the cloud
Say you would like to collect it
a2-220-consolidation.target: Nagyon fáj a torkom és köhögök. Az orvos felírt egy e-receptet a felhőbe, szeretném kiváltani.
a2-220-consolidation.english: My throat hurts badly and I cough. The doctor put an e-prescription into the cloud, I would like to collect it.
a2-220-consolidation.canDo: I can describe my symptoms at a pharmacy, collect an e-prescription and ask for out-of-hours medical help in Hungarian.

a2-221.title: Communicative Challenge: Do You Have a Pet?
a2-221.scenario: Meg is visiting Gábor's family. Gábor asks whether she has a pet.
a2-221.prompt: Tell Gábor that you have a small cat and that you feed it every morning.
cues: Say you have a small cat
Say you feed it every morning
a2-221.target: Van egy kicsi macskám, és minden reggel etetem.
a2-221.english: I have a small cat, and I feed it every morning.
a2-221.canDo: I can say which pets I have and describe them.

a2-222.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Farm
a2-222.scenario: Petra has never been to Gábor's grandparents' farm. She asks Károly what animals there are.
a2-222.prompt: Tell Petra that there are two horses and five hens on the farm.
cues: Say there are two horses
Say there are five hens
a2-222.target: A tanyán van két ló és öt tyúk.
a2-222.english: On the farm there are two horses and five hens.
a2-222.canDo: I can name the animals on a farm and say how many there are.

a2-223.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungary on the Map
a2-223.scenario: Károly is showing Meg a map of Hungary and asks what she already knows about the country.
a2-223.prompt: Tell Károly that the Danube flows through Budapest and that Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary.
cues: Say the Danube flows through Budapest
Say Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary
a2-223.target: A Duna Budapesten keresztül folyik. A Balaton a legnagyobb tó Magyarországon.
a2-223.english: The Danube flows through Budapest. Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary.
a2-223.canDo: I can name forests, hills, lakes and fields in a landscape.

a2-224.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans for Sunday
a2-224.scenario: Petra asks Meg about her plans for Sunday. Meg loves nature and wants to spend the day in the forest.
a2-224.prompt: Tell Petra that you are going hiking in the forest on Sunday and that you love nature.
cues: Say you are going hiking in the forest on Sunday
Say you love nature
a2-224.target: Vasárnap az erdőbe megyek túrázni. Nagyon szeretem a természetet.
a2-224.english: On Sunday I am going hiking in the forest. I love nature very much.
a2-224.canDo: I can name flowers, trees and grass and say what I see in nature.

a2-225.title: Communicative Challenge: Back from the Village
a2-225.scenario: It is Monday and a colleague at work asks Meg how her weekend trip to the village was.
a2-225.prompt: Tell your colleague that on Saturday you were in a small village, fed the hens and saw a stork.
cues: Say you were in a small village on Saturday
Say you fed the hens and saw a stork
a2-225.target: Szombaton egy kicsi faluban voltam, etettem a tyúkokat, és láttam egy gólyát.
a2-225.english: On Saturday I was in a small village, I fed the hens, and I saw a stork.
a2-225.canDo: I can tell what I did on a weekend trip to the countryside.

a2-225-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling the Family
a2-225-consolidation.scenario: Meg is having dinner with Károly's family and tells them about the weekend in the village.
a2-225-consolidation.prompt: Tell them that you walked the dog in the forest, that there are many flowers in the grass, and that you love nature.
cues: Say you walked the dog in the forest
Say there are many flowers in the grass
Say you love nature
a2-225-consolidation.target: Sétáltattam a kutyát az erdőben. A fűben sok virág van, és nagyon szeretem a természetet.
a2-225-consolidation.english: I walked the dog in the forest. There are many flowers in the grass, and I love nature very much.
a2-225-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about pets, farm animals and the countryside, and tell about a weekend trip.

a2-226.title: Communicative Challenge: A Flat Phone
a2-226.scenario: Meg and Károly are on the metro. Meg's phone has run out of battery and there is no signal.
a2-226.prompt: Tell Károly that your phone has run out of battery and ask whether he has a charger on him.
cues: Say your phone has run out of battery
Ask if he has a charger on him
a2-226.target: Lemerült a mobilom. Van nálad töltő?
a2-226.english: My phone has run out of battery. Do you have a charger on you?
a2-226.canDo: I can say my phone has run out of battery and ask someone for a charger.

a2-227.title: Communicative Challenge: The Wifi Password
a2-227.scenario: Meg is at her colleague Petra's flat and wants to get online and to send Petra a file. Petra is in the kitchen.
a2-227.prompt: Ask Petra for the wifi password and for her e-mail address, and say that you are sending her a file.
cues: Ask for the wifi password
Ask for her e-mail address
Say you are sending her a file
a2-227.target: Mi a wifi jelszó? És mi az e-mail címed? Küldök neked egy fájlt.
a2-227.english: What is the wifi password? And what is your e-mail address? I'm sending you a file.
a2-227.canDo: I can ask for the wifi password and give or ask for an e-mail address.

a2-228.title: Communicative Challenge: Tickets in the App
a2-228.scenario: Meg and Károly want to go to a concert. Meg has the ticket app open on the sofa.
a2-228.prompt: Tell Károly that you booked two tickets for the concert in the app and paid by card.
cues: Say you booked two tickets in the app
Say you paid by card
a2-228.target: Az alkalmazásban foglaltam két jegyet a koncertre, és kártyával fizettem.
a2-228.english: I booked two tickets for the concert in the app, and I paid by card.
a2-228.canDo: I can say that I booked, ordered or paid for something in an app.

a2-229.title: Communicative Challenge: The Frozen Computer
a2-229.scenario: Meg is writing a report at work. Her computer froze, but it works again now. Her colleague Petra sits at the next desk and asks what happened.
a2-229.prompt: Tell Petra that your computer froze and that you restarted it.
cues: Say your computer froze
Say you restarted it
a2-229.english: My computer froze, but I restarted it.
a2-229.canDo: I can say that my computer or phone froze and that I restarted it.

a2-230.title: Communicative Challenge: A Call to South Africa
a2-230.scenario: It is Sunday. Meg and Károly are on a video call with Meg's mother in South Africa. The picture is good, but the sound is gone.
a2-230.prompt: Tell your mother that you can see her but cannot hear her, and that you are switching the sound on.
cues: Say you can see her
Say you cannot hear her
Say you are switching the sound on
a2-230.target: Látlak, de nem hallak. Egy pillanat, bekapcsolom a hangot.
a2-230.english: I can see you, but I can't hear you. One moment, I'm switching the sound on.
a2-230.canDo: I can say whether I can see and hear someone on a video call.

a2-230-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Call Was Cut Off
a2-230-consolidation.scenario: Meg's video call to South Africa has just broken off. Károly is sitting next to her.
a2-230-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the call was cut off because the computer froze, and that you are restarting it.
cues: Say the call was cut off
Say the computer froze
Say you are restarting it
a2-230-consolidation.target: Megszakadt a hívás, mert lefagyott a számítógép. Újraindítom.
a2-230-consolidation.english: The call was cut off because the computer froze. I'm restarting it.
a2-230-consolidation.canDo: I can solve a small technology problem: say what froze or ran out of battery and what I did about it.

a2-231.title: Communicative Challenge: Petra's Birthday
a2-231.scenario: It is Petra's birthday and Meg arrives at her party with some flowers.
a2-231.prompt: Wish Petra a happy birthday, congratulate her and say that you brought her a bunch of flowers.
cues: Wish her a happy birthday
Congratulate her
Say you brought her a bunch of flowers
a2-231.target: Boldog születésnapot, Petra! Gratulálok! Hoztam neked egy csokor virágot.
a2-231.english: Happy birthday, Petra! Congratulations! I brought you a bunch of flowers.
a2-231.canDo: I can wish someone a happy birthday or name day and congratulate them.

a2-232.title: Communicative Challenge: Christmas Eve Dinner
a2-232.scenario: It is the evening of 24 December. Károly asks Meg what the family eats at Christmas Eve dinner.
a2-232.prompt: Tell Károly that on Christmas Eve your family eats fish soup and bejgli, and wish him a happy Christmas.
cues: Say your family eats fish soup on Christmas Eve
Say your family eats bejgli too
Wish him a happy Christmas
a2-232.target: Szenteste halászlét és bejglit eszünk. Boldog karácsonyt, Károly!
a2-232.english: On Christmas Eve we eat fish soup and bejgli. Happy Christmas, Károly!
a2-232.canDo: I can say what we eat and do on Christmas Eve and wish someone a happy Christmas.

a2-233.title: Communicative Challenge: Easter Monday
a2-233.scenario: It is Easter Monday. Meg's mother, visiting from South Africa, asks Meg what happens at Easter in Hungary.
a2-233.prompt: Tell her that at Easter the boys sprinkle the girls and the girls give them a painted egg.
cues: Say the boys sprinkle the girls
Say the girls give the boys a painted egg
a2-233.target: Húsvétkor a fiúk locsolják a lányokat, és a lányok hímes tojást adnak a fiúknak.
a2-233.english: At Easter the boys sprinkle the girls, and the girls give the boys a painted egg.
a2-233.canDo: I can say what happens at Easter in Hungary.

a2-234.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fifteenth of March
a2-234.scenario: It is 15 March. Meg's mother, visiting Budapest, sees red-white-green badges on many coats and asks why the shops are closed.
a2-234.prompt: Tell your mother that 15 March is a national holiday and that in 1848 there was a revolution in Hungary.
cues: Say 15 March is a national holiday
Say there was a revolution in 1848
a2-234.target: Március tizenötödike nemzeti ünnep. 1848-ban forradalom volt Magyarországon.
a2-234.english: 15 March is a national holiday. In 1848 there was a revolution in Hungary.
a2-234.canDo: I can say when a national holiday is and what it remembers.

a2-235.title: Communicative Challenge: An Invitation
a2-235.scenario: Meg wants to ask her friend Petra to dinner on Saturday.
a2-235.prompt: Invite Petra to dinner on Saturday and ask whether she is coming.
cues: Invite her to dinner
Say it is on Saturday
Ask if she is coming
a2-235.english: On Saturday I'm inviting you to dinner. Are you coming?
a2-235.canDo: I can invite someone to a family celebration.

a2-235-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: New Year's Eve
a2-235-consolidation.scenario: It is New Year's Eve and a pot of lentils is on the stove. Petra arrives at Meg and Károly's door.
a2-235-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra to come in, wish her a happy New Year and say that you eat lentils on New Year's Day.
cues: Tell her to come in
Wish her a happy New Year
Say you eat lentils on New Year's Day
a2-235-consolidation.target: Gyere be! Boldog új évet! Újév napján lencsét eszünk.
a2-235-consolidation.english: Come in! Happy New Year! On New Year's Day we eat lentils.
a2-235-consolidation.canDo: I can wish people well at a birthday, name day or holiday and say when it is.

b1-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Back Then at Home
b1-01-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what life was like at home in South Africa when she was a child. You (Meg) say that back then your family lived there and that the mood at home was always good.
b1-01-01.prompt: Tell Petra where you lived back then and that the mood at home was always good.
cues: Say which time you mean
Say where your family lived
Say what the mood at home was like
b1-01-01.target: Akkoriban Dél-Afrikában laktunk. Mindig jó volt a hangulat otthon.
b1-01-01.english: Back then we lived in South Africa. The mood at home was always good.
b1-01-01.canDo: I can open a story by naming when and where it happened.

b1-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Letter
b1-01-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she did this morning after she arrived at the office. You (Meg) read the letter that was on your desk, and Petra was making coffee at the same time.
b1-01-02.prompt: Tell Petra that after you arrived at the office you read the letter, and say what she was doing at the same time.
cues: Say what you did after you arrived at the office
Say what Petra was doing at the same time
b1-01-02.target: Miután megérkeztem az irodába, elolvastam a levelet. Eközben Petra kávét főzött.
b1-01-02.english: After I arrived at the office, I read the letter. Meanwhile Petra was making coffee.
b1-01-02.canDo: I can say that one event happened after another using miután + past tense.

b1-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Trip
b1-01-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg and Károly what they did before they set off on their trip. You (Meg) checked the tickets and closed the window.
b1-01-03.prompt: Tell Petra that before you and Károly set off, you checked the tickets and closed the window.
cues: Say what you did before you set off
Add a second thing you did
b1-01-03.target: Mielőtt elindultunk, ellenőriztük a jegyeket, és becsuktuk az ablakot.
b1-01-03.english: Before we set off, we checked the tickets and closed the window.
b1-01-03.canDo: I can say that one event happened before another using mielőtt + past tense.

b1-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Late at Petra's
b1-01-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the evening at Petra's went. You (Meg) searched for her house for a long time, arrived in the end, and the result was that you were two hours late.
b1-01-04.prompt: Tell Károly that you searched for Petra's house for a long time, that you arrived in the end, and that you ended up two hours late.
cues: Say how long you searched, and for what
Say how it ended
Say what the result was
b1-01-04.target: Sokáig kerestük Petra házát, végül megérkeztünk. Az eredmény az volt, hogy két órát késtünk.
b1-01-04.english: We looked for Petra's house for a long time, in the end we arrived. The result was that we were two hours late.
b1-01-04.canDo: I can close a story using végül and az eredmény az volt, hogy.

b1-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Day of the Storm
b1-01-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg to tell the story of a trip in one go. Back then you lived in a small village; after you arrived you went for a walk; before you went home a storm came; in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-05.prompt: Tell Anna the whole story: set the scene, say what you did after you arrived, say what happened before you went home, and say how it ended.
cues: Set the scene
Say what you did after you arrived
Say what happened before you went home
Say how it ended
b1-01-05.target: Akkoriban egy kis faluban laktunk, és miután megérkeztünk, elmentünk sétálni. Mielőtt hazamentünk, jött egy vihar, de végül mindenki elégedett volt.
b1-01-05.english: Back then we lived in a small village, and after we arrived we went for a walk. Before we went home a storm came, but in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-05.canDo: I can put opening, sequencing, turning point and closing language together in one story.

b1-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Busy Day at Work
b1-01-consolidation.scenario: Anna asks Meg to tell the story of a busy day at work: back then you worked a lot on the project; after the letter arrived you went to Petra; before you went home you phoned Károly; in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna the story of the busy day: how it started, what you did after the letter arrived, what you did before going home, and how it ended.
cues: Set the scene
Say what you did after the letter arrived
Say what you did before you went home
Say how it ended
b1-01-consolidation.target: Akkoriban sokat dolgoztam a projekten. Miután megérkezett a levél, elmentem Petrához, és mielőtt hazamentem, felhívtam Károlyt. Az eredmény az volt, hogy mindenki elégedett volt.
b1-01-consolidation.english: Back then I worked a lot on the project. After the letter arrived, I went to Petra, and before I went home I phoned Károly. The result was that everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-consolidation.canDo: I can open a story, sequence its events, mark its turning point and close it.

b1-orszagma-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Hungary Lies
b1-orszagma-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you where Hungary is.
b1-orszagma-01.prompt: Tell the official where Hungary lies and say that it has no direct coastline.
cues: Say where Hungary lies
Say it has no direct coastline
b1-orszagma-01.target: Magyarország Közép-Európában, a Kárpát-medencében fekszik. Szárazföldi ország, nincs közvetlen tengerpartja.
b1-orszagma-01.english: Hungary lies in Central Europe, in the Carpathian Basin. It is a landlocked country and has no direct coastline.
b1-orszagma-01.canDo: I can explain where Hungary is located, using Közép-Európában and a Kárpát-medencében.

b1-orszagma-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Counties and the Capital
b1-orszagma-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about Hungary's counties and its capital.
b1-orszagma-02.prompt: Tell the official how many counties Hungary has and say where the capital lies.
cues: Say how many counties there are
Name the capital and say where it lies
b1-orszagma-02.target: Magyarországon tizenkilenc vármegye van. Budapest a főváros, a Duna mentén fekszik.
b1-orszagma-02.english: There are nineteen counties in Hungary. Budapest is the capital, and it lies along the Danube.
b1-orszagma-02.canDo: I can say that Hungary has 19 counties (vármegyék) and that Budapest is the capital.

b1-orszagma-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Colours of the Flag
b1-orszagma-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the national flag.
b1-orszagma-03.prompt: Tell the official how many stripes the flag has and what the three colours stand for.
cues: Say how many stripes the flag has
Say what each colour stands for
b1-orszagma-03.target: A lobogó három vízszintes sávból áll. A hagyomány szerint a piros az erőt, a fehér a hűséget, a zöld a reményt jelképezi.
b1-orszagma-03.english: The flag consists of three horizontal stripes. According to tradition, red stands for strength, white for loyalty and green for hope.
b1-orszagma-03.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian flag's colours (piros, fehér, zöld) and their traditional symbolic meanings.

b1-orszagma-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungary's Neighbours
b1-orszagma-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the countries around Hungary.
b1-orszagma-04.prompt: Tell the official how many neighbours Hungary has and name two of them with the direction they lie in.
cues: Say how many countries Hungary borders
Name two of them and where they lie
b1-orszagma-04.target: Magyarország hét országgal határos. Északon Szlovákiával, keleten Romániával határos.
b1-orszagma-04.english: Hungary borders seven countries. In the north it borders Slovakia, in the east Romania.
b1-orszagma-04.canDo: I can name Hungary's seven neighbouring countries and say where some of them lie using compass directions.

b1-orszagma-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Summary
b1-orszagma-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official greets you and asks for a short summary of Hungary's geography.
b1-orszagma-05.prompt: Greet the official, then say where Hungary lies and name its two big rivers.
cues: Greet the official
Say where Hungary lies
Name the two big rivers
b1-orszagma-05.target: Jó napot kívánok! Ha a földrajzi fekvést tekintjük, Magyarország a Kárpát-medencében fekszik. Két nagy folyója a Duna és a Tisza.
b1-orszagma-05.english: Good day! If we consider the geographic location, Hungary lies in the Carpathian Basin. Its two big rivers are the Danube and the Tisza.
b1-orszagma-05.canDo: I can summarize Hungary's location, regions and rivers in a few connected sentences.

b1-orszagma-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Two More Questions
b1-orszagma-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks two more questions about the map of Hungary.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.prompt: Say which region Pécs and Debrecen are in, then say where the Tisza flows into.
cues: Say where Pécs is
Say where Debrecen is
Say where the Tisza flows into
b1-orszagma-consolidation.target: Pécs a Dunántúlon van, Debrecen pedig az Alföldön. A Tisza a Dunába torkollik.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.english: Pécs is in Transdanubia, and Debrecen is on the Great Plain. The Tisza flows into the Danube.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Hungary's location, counties, rivers and cities.

b1-02-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Have You Tried Sushi?
b1-02-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg whether she has ever tried sushi. You (Meg) have already tried it, but you have never tried halászlé.
b1-02-01.prompt: Tell Petra that you have already tried sushi and that you have never tried halászlé.
cues: Say that you have already tried sushi
Say that you have never tried halászlé
b1-02-01.target: Igen, már próbáltam szusit, de még soha nem próbáltam ki a halászlét.
b1-02-01.english: Yes, I have already tried sushi, but I have never tried halászlé.
b1-02-01.canDo: I can say I've already had an experience using már + past tense.

b1-02-02.title: Communicative Challenge: My First Trip Alone
b1-02-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg about the first time she travelled alone. You (Meg) were very nervous before you set off, and it was a big challenge.
b1-02-02.prompt: Tell Petra that you travelled alone for the first time in your life and how you felt before you set off.
cues: Say that it was your first time in your life
Say how you felt before you set off
b1-02-02.target: Életemben először utaztam egyedül, és nagy kihívás volt. Mielőtt elindultam, nagyon ideges voltam.
b1-02-02.english: I travelled alone for the first time in my life, and it was a big challenge. Before I set off, I was very nervous.
b1-02-02.canDo: I can mark an event as a first-time experience using először and életemben először.

b1-02-03.title: Communicative Challenge: My Mother's Cooking
b1-02-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg which food she remembers best from home. You (Meg) love the meals your mother prepared, and your grandmother's soup made a deep impression on you.
b1-02-03.prompt: Tell Petra that you love the meals your mother prepared and that your grandmother's soup made a deep impression on you.
cues: Say that you love the meals your mother prepared
Say that your grandmother's soup made a deep impression on you
b1-02-03.target: Szeretem az anyám által elkészített ételeket. A nagymamám levese mély benyomást tett rám.
b1-02-03.english: I love the meals prepared by my mother. My grandmother's soup made a deep impression on me.
b1-02-03.canDo: I can form a past participle from a verb and use it as an adjective, like elkészített étel.

b1-02-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking Back
b1-02-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she has changed over the last years. You (Meg) were afraid of new situations before, but you have changed a lot since then.
b1-02-04.prompt: Tell Károly that looking back at the past years you have changed a lot, and what you were afraid of before.
cues: Say that you are looking back at the past years
Say that you have changed a lot
Say what you were afraid of before
b1-02-04.target: Ha visszatekintek az elmúlt évekre, sokat változtam. Azelőtt féltem az új helyzetektől.
b1-02-04.english: If I look back at the past years, I have changed a lot. Before that, I was afraid of new situations.
b1-02-04.canDo: I can frame a reflection on the past using ha visszatekintek, and say what I am looking back at with -ra/-re.

b1-02-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Trips
b1-02-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg about her trips to Japan. You (Meg) have been there before, but this was your first time without Károly; you were nervous before, and you have been getting braver since.
b1-02-05.prompt: Tell Petra that you have already been to Japan, that this was your first time without Károly, and how you have changed since then.
cues: Say that you have already been to Japan
Say that this time was the first time
Say how you have changed since then
b1-02-05.target: Már jártam Japánban, de most jártam ott először Károly nélkül. Azelőtt ideges voltam, azóta egyre bátrabb vagyok.
b1-02-05.english: I have already been to Japan, but this time I was there for the first time without Károly. Before I was nervous; since then I have been getting braver and braver.
b1-02-05.canDo: I can put experiential már/még soha, first-time framing, participle adjectives and looking-back language together in one reflection.

b1-02-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Been There, Never Eaten That
b1-02-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the places she has visited and the foods she has eaten. You (Meg) have already been to Japan, but you have never eaten halászlé.
b1-02-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that you have already been to Japan and that you have never eaten halászlé.
cues: Say that you have already been to Japan
Say that you have never eaten halászlé
b1-02-consolidation.target: Már jártam Japánban, de még soha nem ettem halászlét.
b1-02-consolidation.english: I have already been to Japan, but I have never eaten halászlé.
b1-02-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about experiences using már and még soha nem with past tense.

b1-karpatmedence-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Romans
b1-karpatmedence-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks which peoples lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Romans.
b1-karpatmedence-01.prompt: Name the two peoples and say where the Celts settled.
cues: Name the two peoples who lived here before the Romans
Say where the Celts settled
b1-karpatmedence-01.target: A rómaiak előtt pannon törzsek és kelták éltek itt. A kelták a folyók közelében letelepedtek.
b1-karpatmedence-01.english: Before the Romans, Pannonian tribes and Celts lived here. The Celts settled near the rivers.
b1-karpatmedence-01.canDo: I can name two peoples who lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Romans: the Pannonian tribes and the Celts.

b1-karpatmedence-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Romans on the Danube
b1-karpatmedence-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks how the Romans came to Pannonia.
b1-karpatmedence-02.prompt: Say what the Romans did, in order: the legions reached the Danube, they conquered the right bank and finally founded the province.
cues: Say that the legions reached the Danube
Say that the Romans conquered the right bank
Say that they finally founded Pannonia
b1-karpatmedence-02.target: A légiók elérték a Dunát, majd a rómaiak meghódították a Duna jobb partját, végül Pannónia tartományt alapítottak.
b1-karpatmedence-02.english: The legions reached the Danube, then the Romans conquered the right bank of the Danube, and finally they founded the province of Pannonia.
b1-karpatmedence-02.canDo: I can explain when and how the Romans conquered the western part of the Carpathian Basin.

b1-karpatmedence-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Migration Period
b1-karpatmedence-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the népvándorlás was.
b1-karpatmedence-03.prompt: Say what the népvándorlás was and what the Slavs did while the Avars ruled.
cues: Say what the népvándorlás was
Say what the Slavs did while the Avars ruled
b1-karpatmedence-03.target: A népvándorlás az az időszak, amikor sok nép vándorolt át Európán. Míg az avarok uralkodtak, szláv csoportok letelepedtek a folyók mentén.
b1-karpatmedence-03.english: The népvándorlás was the period when many peoples migrated across Europe. While the Avars ruled, Slavic groups settled along the rivers.
b1-karpatmedence-03.canDo: I can explain what the népvándorlás (Migration Period) was.

b1-karpatmedence-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Lived Here Before?
b1-karpatmedence-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks who lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars.
b1-karpatmedence-04.prompt: Name the peoples in the order they came: the Celts, then the Romans, then the Huns and the Avars.
cues: Say who lived here first
Say what the Romans founded
Say who followed in the Migration Period
b1-karpatmedence-04.target: A kelták éltek itt először, majd a rómaiak alapítottak tartományt. Később hunok és avarok követték egymást.
b1-karpatmedence-04.english: The Celts lived here first, then the Romans founded a province. Later the Huns and Avars followed one another.
b1-karpatmedence-04.canDo: I can summarize, in my own words, which peoples lived in the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars, in the order they arrived.

b1-karpatmedence-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Eve of 895
b1-karpatmedence-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the situation was in the Carpathian Basin at the end of the 9th century.
b1-karpatmedence-05.prompt: Say that no single people ruled the whole basin and that the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
cues: Say that no single people ruled the whole basin
Say that many peoples lived side by side
Say that the Magyar tribes set out from the east
b1-karpatmedence-05.target: A 9. század végén egyetlen nép sem uralkodott az egész medencében. Sok nép és helyi uralkodó élt egymás mellett, és ekkor indultak el keletről a magyar törzsek.
b1-karpatmedence-05.english: At the end of the 9th century, no single people ruled the whole basin. Many peoples and local rulers lived side by side, and this is when the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
b1-karpatmedence-05.canDo: I can describe the political situation in the Carpathian Basin at the end of the 9th century, after the fall of the Avar Khaganate.

b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From the Celts to 895
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks for a short summary of the Carpathian Basin before the Magyars.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.prompt: Say who lived here, what the Romans founded, who followed in the Migration Period and what the Magyar tribes did at the end.
cues: Say who lived here first
Say what the Romans founded
Say who followed in the Migration Period
Say what the Magyar tribes did at the end
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.target: A kelták éltek itt, majd a rómaiak tartományt alapítottak. A népvándorlás alatt hunok és avarok követték egymást, végül elindultak keletről a magyar törzsek.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.english: The Celts lived here, then the Romans founded a province. During the Migration Period the Huns and Avars followed one another, and finally the Magyar tribes set out from the east.
b1-karpatmedence-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate the Kárpát-medence's pre-Magyar history: early peoples, Roman Pannonia, the Migration Period and the eve of the honfoglalás.

b1-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Job I Want
b1-03-01.scenario: Petra tells Meg about a job at her company. You (Meg) say that you would like this particular job, and that you wish your plan would succeed.
b1-03-01.prompt: Tell Petra that you would like this job and that you wish your plan would succeed.
cues: Say you would like this particular job
Say you wish your plan would succeed
b1-03-01.target: Szeretném ezt az állást. Szeretném, ha sikerülne a tervem.
b1-03-01.english: I would like this job. I wish my plan would succeed.
b1-03-01.canDo: I can tell szeretném and szeretnék apart, and use the definite conditional for a specific wish.

b1-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: If Only I Had More Time
b1-03-02.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she wishes for. You (Meg) wish you had more time, and you wish Károly would come with you on the trip.
b1-03-02.prompt: Tell Anna that you wish you had more time and that Károly would come with you.
cues: Make an emphatic wish about your time
Say you wish Károly would come too
b1-03-02.target: Bárcsak lenne több időm! Szeretném, ha Károly is eljönne velem.
b1-03-02.english: If only I had more time! I wish Károly would come with me too.
b1-03-02.canDo: I can make an emphatic wish with bárcsak + conditional.

b1-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Want for the Project
b1-03-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she wants for the project at work. You (Meg) want your plan to succeed and your career to develop.
b1-03-03.prompt: Tell Petra that you want your plan to succeed and that you would like your career to develop.
cues: Say you want your plan to succeed
Say you would like your career to develop
b1-03-03.target: Azt akarom, hogy sikerüljön a tervem. Azt szeretném, hogy fejlődjön a karrierem.
b1-03-03.english: I want my plan to succeed. I would like my career to develop.
b1-03-03.canDo: I can form the -jon/-jen third-person command and subjunctive form of a verb.

b1-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why I Get Up Early
b1-03-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she gets up so early and checks her work twice. You (Meg) get up early to catch the train, and you check your work so that you don't make a mistake.
b1-03-04.prompt: Tell Károly why you get up early and why you check your work twice.
cues: Say why you get up early
Say what you want to avoid by checking your work
b1-03-04.target: Korán kelek azért, hogy elérjem a vonatot. Kétszer ellenőrzöm a munkámat, nehogy hibát csináljak.
b1-03-04.english: I get up early so that I catch the train. I check my work twice so that I don't make a mistake.
b1-03-04.canDo: I can explain the purpose of an action using azért, hogy + -jon/-jen.

b1-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Five-Year Plan
b1-03-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg about her five-year plan. You (Meg) wish that within five years you could start your own company, and you put a little money aside every month so that this comes true.
b1-03-05.prompt: Tell Anna about your plan in one longer sentence: your wish for the next five years and what you do so that it comes true.
cues: Say what you wish for in five years
Say what you do so that it comes true
b1-03-05.target: Szeretném, ha öt éven belül sikerülne saját céget alapítanom, ezért minden hónapban félreteszek egy kis pénzt azért, hogy megvalósuljon a tervem.
b1-03-05.english: I wish that within five years I could start my own company, so every month I put a little money aside so that my plan comes true.
b1-03-05.canDo: I can combine szeretném, ha and azért, hogy in one longer sentence about my plans.

b1-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Wishes at Lunch
b1-03-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg about her project at lunch. You (Meg) wish the plan would succeed, and you wish you had more time.
b1-03-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra that you wish your plan would succeed and that you wish you had more time.
cues: Say you wish your plan would succeed
Make an emphatic wish about your time
b1-03-consolidation.target: Szeretném, ha sikerülne a tervem. Bárcsak lenne több időm!
b1-03-consolidation.english: I wish my plan would succeed. If only I had more time!
b1-03-consolidation.canDo: I can wish for something using szeretném, ha and bárcsak + conditional.

b1-honfoglalas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Tribes Left
b1-honfoglalas-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you why the Magyar tribes left Etelköz. You say that the Pechenegs put pressure on them and that the Khazars, their allies, had weakened.
b1-honfoglalas-01.prompt: Tell the official why the Magyar tribes left Etelköz: the Pecheneg pressure and the weakened Khazar allies.
cues: Say what the Pechenegs did, and what the tribes then did
Say what had happened to the Khazar allies
b1-honfoglalas-01.target: Miután a besenyők nyomást gyakoroltak rájuk, a magyar törzsek elhagyták Etelközt. A kazárok meggyengültek, ezért nem tudták megvédeni a magyarokat.
b1-honfoglalas-01.english: After the Pechenegs put pressure on them, the Magyar tribes left Etelköz. The Khazars had weakened, so they could not protect the Magyars.
b1-honfoglalas-01.canDo: I can explain why the Magyar tribes migrated west, including the role of Pecheneg pressure and the weakening of their Khazar allies.

b1-honfoglalas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Over the Mountains
b1-honfoglalas-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how the Magyar tribes crossed the Carpathians. You say what tradition tells about the main army and the other tribes.
b1-honfoglalas-02.prompt: Tell the official which pass the main army used, according to tradition, and that other tribes followed through other passes.
cues: Say what tradition tells about the main army
Say what the other tribes did afterwards
b1-honfoglalas-02.target: A hagyomány szerint a fő sereg a Vereckei-hágón kelt át 895-ben, majd más törzsek más hágókon követték őket.
b1-honfoglalas-02.english: According to tradition, the main army crossed at the Verecke Pass in 895, and then other tribes followed them through other passes.
b1-honfoglalas-02.canDo: I can describe how the Magyar tribes crossed the Carpathian mountains around 895.

b1-honfoglalas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Seven Chieftains
b1-honfoglalas-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the blood oath of the seven chieftains and about Árpád. You say that, according to tradition, the leaders united by a blood oath, and that Árpád led the tribes into the basin.
b1-honfoglalas-03.prompt: Tell the official about the blood oath of the seven chieftains and say who led the tribes into the Carpathian Basin.
cues: Say what the chieftains did, according to tradition
Say who led the tribes into the basin
b1-honfoglalas-03.target: A hagyomány szerint a hét törzs vezetői vérszerződéssel egyesültek. Árpád vezette be a törzseket a Kárpát-medencébe.
b1-honfoglalas-03.english: According to tradition, the leaders of the seven tribes united by a blood oath. Árpád led the tribes into the Carpathian Basin.
b1-honfoglalas-03.canDo: I can explain the traditional account of the vérszerződés, the blood oath among the seven tribal chieftains.

b1-honfoglalas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Settling the Plain
b1-honfoglalas-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how the Magyars settled the Carpathian Basin. You say that they occupied the Great Plain first and then expanded gradually, and that they defeated the Bavarian army at Pozsony in 907.
b1-honfoglalas-04.prompt: Tell the official which area the Magyars took first, how they spread, and what happened at Pozsony in 907.
cues: Say which area they occupied first and how they spread
Say what happened at Pozsony in 907
b1-honfoglalas-04.target: Miután a magyarok elfoglalták az Alföldet, fokozatosan terjeszkedtek. 907-ben a pozsonyi csatában legyőzték a bajor sereget.
b1-honfoglalas-04.english: After the Magyars occupied the Great Plain, they gradually expanded. In 907, at the Battle of Pozsony, they defeated the Bavarian army.
b1-honfoglalas-04.canDo: I can describe how the Magyar tribes gradually occupied the Carpathian Basin over several years rather than all at once.

b1-honfoglalas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Why It Still Matters
b1-honfoglalas-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you why the honfoglalás still matters today. You say that it is an important part of Hungarian national identity and that it has no state holiday of its own.
b1-honfoglalas-05.prompt: Tell the official why the honfoglalás still matters and say whether it has its own state holiday.
cues: Say why the honfoglalás still matters
Say whether it has its own state holiday
b1-honfoglalas-05.target: A honfoglalás ma is fontos része a magyar nemzeti identitásnak. Saját állami ünnepe nincs.
b1-honfoglalas-05.english: The honfoglalás is still an important part of Hungarian national identity. It has no state holiday of its own.
b1-honfoglalas-05.canDo: I can explain why 895 and the honfoglalás matter to Hungarian national identity today, including for the citizenship exam.

b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Whole Story
b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to tell the story of the honfoglalás in a few sentences: why the tribes left, who led them, and where they settled.
b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official in a few sentences why the tribes left Etelköz, who led them into the basin, and what they did there.
cues: Say why the tribes left
Say who led them into the basin
Say what they did in the basin
b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.target: A besenyők nyomása nyugatra kényszerítette a magyar törzseket. Árpád vezette be őket a Kárpát-medencébe, és 907-ben a pozsonyi csatában biztosították új hazájukat.
b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.english: Pecheneg pressure forced the Magyar tribes west. Árpád led them into the Carpathian Basin, and in 907, at the Battle of Pozsony, they secured their new homeland.
b1-honfoglalas-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate the honfoglalás story: why the Magyar tribes left the steppe, how they crossed the Carpathians, who led them, how they settled the basin, and why 895 still matters today.

b1-04-01.title: Communicative Challenge: In Your Place
b1-04-01.scenario: Petra tells you that a company has offered her a new job, but she is unsure and doesn't know what to do.
b1-04-01.prompt: Give Petra advice: say what you would do in her place and that the job is a good chance.
cues: Say what you would do in her place
Say that the job is a good chance
b1-04-01.target: A helyedben én elfogadnám az állást. Szerintem nagy lehetőség.
b1-04-01.english: In your place, I would accept the job. I think it's a great opportunity.
b1-04-01.canDo: I can give advice by imagining myself in someone else's place using a helyedben + conditional.

b1-04-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rest a Little
b1-04-02.scenario: Meg has had a long week at the office. She tells you she is very tired but still has a lot to do.
b1-04-02.prompt: Suggest that she could rest a little, and say it would be better if she went home earlier.
cues: Suggest that she could rest a little
Say it would be better if she went home earlier
b1-04-02.target: Pihenhetnél egy kicsit. Jobb lenne, ha korábban hazamennél.
b1-04-02.english: You could rest a little. It would be better if you went home earlier.
b1-04-02.canDo: I can soften a suggestion using -hat/-het + conditional, like kipróbálhatnád.

b1-04-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Train or Bus
b1-04-03.scenario: Károly cannot decide whether to travel by train or by bus this weekend, and he asks what you think.
b1-04-03.prompt: Tell him one advantage and one disadvantage of the train, and say which you would choose.
cues: Say one advantage of the train
Say one disadvantage of the train
Say which one you would choose
b1-04-03.target: Egyrészt olcsóbb a vonat, másrészt tovább tart az út. Én inkább vonattal mennék, mint busszal.
b1-04-03.english: On one hand the train is cheaper, on the other hand the trip takes longer. I would rather go by train than by bus.
b1-04-03.canDo: I can lay out an advantage and a disadvantage side by side using egyrészt... másrészt...

b1-04-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Worried Warning
b1-04-04.scenario: Meg says she wants to go hiking in the mountains tomorrow, but the weather is very bad.
b1-04-04.prompt: Warn Meg not to set off, and say it could be dangerous.
cues: Warn her not to set off
Say it could be dangerous
b1-04-04.english: Don't set off, it could be dangerous!
b1-04-04.canDo: I can warn someone caringly, not to do something, using nehogy + imperative.

b1-04-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Talking It Through
b1-04-05.scenario: Meg tells you she wants to cancel her meeting with her boss because she is nervous about it.
b1-04-05.prompt: Say what you would do in her place, and warn her not to rush the decision.
cues: Say what you would do in her place
Warn her not to rush the decision
b1-04-05.target: A helyedben én nem mondanám le a találkozót. Nehogy siess a döntéssel!
b1-04-05.english: In your place, I wouldn't cancel the meeting. Don't rush the decision!
b1-04-05.canDo: I can combine this unit's advice tools — a helyedben, -hat/-het suggestions, egyrészt/másrészt, nehogy — in one conversation.

b1-04-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: If I Were You
b1-04-consolidation.scenario: Meg has a problem with a colleague at the office and wonders whether to tell her boss.
b1-04-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you would do if you were in her place.
cues: Say what you would do if you were in her place
Say that you would tell the boss
b1-04-consolidation.target: Ha én a helyedben lennék, szólnék a főnöknek.
b1-04-consolidation.english: If I were in your place, I would tell the boss.
b1-04-consolidation.canDo: I can give advice by imagining myself in someone's place, with a helyedben and ha ... lennék.

b1-05-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Along
b1-05-01.scenario: Petra asks how you get on with your new colleague.
b1-05-01.prompt: Say that you get along well and that you always help each other.
cues: Say that you get along well
Say that you always help each other
b1-05-01.target: Nagyon jól kijövünk egymással, és mindig segítünk egymásnak.
b1-05-01.english: We get along very well with each other, and we always help each other.
b1-05-01.canDo: I can say what people do to or with each other using egymás.

b1-05-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Fell Out, Made Up
b1-05-02.scenario: Károly notices that you and your friend Meg were not talking to each other last week.
b1-05-02.prompt: Say that you and Meg fell out at the weekend, but made up yesterday.
cues: Say that you fell out at the weekend
Say that you made up yesterday
b1-05-02.target: Összevesztünk a hétvégén, de tegnap kibékültünk.
b1-05-02.english: We fell out at the weekend, but we made up yesterday.
b1-05-02.canDo: I can talk about arguing and falling out with veszekedik and összevész.

b1-05-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Someone to Rely On
b1-05-03.scenario: Meg is going through a hard time and asks whether she can rely on you.
b1-05-03.prompt: Say that in hard times you can rely on each other, and that you always take care of her.
cues: Say that in hard times you can rely on each other
Say that you always take care of her
b1-05-03.target: Nehéz időkben támaszkodhatunk egymásra. Mindig gondoskodom rólad.
b1-05-03.english: In hard times we can rely on each other. I always take care of you.
b1-05-03.canDo: I can talk about caring for, relying on, and being attached to someone with gondoskodik, támaszkodik and ragaszkodik.

b1-05-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Despite the Distance
b1-05-04.scenario: Petra asks why you and your old friend Zsófi are still close, although she lives far away.
b1-05-04.prompt: Say that you are good friends despite living far from each other, and that Zsófi is a friend who always helps.
cues: Say that you are good friends despite the distance
Say what kind of friend Zsófi is
b1-05-04.target: Annak ellenére, hogy messze lakunk egymástól, jó barátok vagyunk. Zsófi olyan barát, aki mindig segít.
b1-05-04.english: Despite the fact that we live far from each other, we are good friends. Zsófi is the kind of friend who always helps.
b1-05-04.canDo: I can concede a contrast with annak ellenére, hogy — "despite the fact that".

b1-05-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Relationship
b1-05-05.scenario: Károly asks you what makes a good relationship.
b1-05-05.prompt: Say what a good relationship needs, and that you take care of each other despite the difficulties.
cues: Say what a good relationship needs
Say that you take care of each other despite the difficulties
b1-05-05.target: Egy jó kapcsolathoz bizalom és kompromisszum kell. Gondoskodunk egymásról, annak ellenére, hogy néha nehéz.
b1-05-05.english: A good relationship needs trust and compromise. We take care of each other, despite the fact that it is sometimes hard.
b1-05-05.canDo: I can put this unit's relationship language together — egymás, conflict and making-up verbs, support verbs, annak ellenére hogy, and aki-descriptions.

b1-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hoping to Make Up
b1-05-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks why you do not talk to Zsófi any more.
b1-05-consolidation.prompt: Say that you fell out, but you hope you will make up one day.
cues: Say that you fell out
Say that you hope you will make up
b1-05-consolidation.target: Annak ellenére, hogy összevesztünk, remélem, hogy kibékülünk.
b1-05-consolidation.english: Despite the fact that we fell out, I hope we will make up.
b1-05-consolidation.canDo: I can say what people do to or with each other using egymás, and how well they get along.

b1-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who We Are Looking For
b1-06-01.scenario: Petra, your colleague at the office, asks what kind of colleague your team needs.
b1-06-01.prompt: Tell Petra that your team is looking for a colleague who speaks English.
cues: Say that you are looking for a colleague
Say that he or she speaks English
b1-06-01.english: We are looking for a colleague who speaks English.
b1-06-01.canDo: I can form and use the present participle -ó/-ő as an adjective.

b1-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: It Will Sort Itself Out
b1-06-02.scenario: Meg is worried about a problem at the office and asks how things look.
b1-06-02.prompt: Tell Meg that the problem will soon resolve itself and that the meeting ends at noon.
cues: Say the problem will soon resolve itself
Say the meeting ends at noon
b1-06-02.target: A probléma hamarosan megoldódik, és a megbeszélés délben befejeződik.
b1-06-02.english: The problem will soon resolve itself, and the meeting ends at noon.
b1-06-02.canDo: I can use mediopassive verbs ending in -ódik/-ődik to describe events unfolding.

b1-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Applying for the Job
b1-06-03.scenario: Károly asks what you plan to do about the job advert you saw yesterday.
b1-06-03.prompt: Say that you would like to apply for the position and that you are going to a job interview tomorrow.
cues: Say you would like to apply for the position
Say you have a job interview tomorrow
b1-06-03.target: Szeretnék jelentkezni az állásra. Holnap állásinterjúra megyek.
b1-06-03.english: I would like to apply for the position. Tomorrow I am going to a job interview.
b1-06-03.canDo: I can use formal verbs for applying to a position (jelentkezik, pályázik).

b1-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Keeping the Deadline
b1-06-04.scenario: Your boss asks whether the report will be ready by Friday, but you still have to talk to a colleague.
b1-06-04.prompt: Say that you still need to coordinate the details with your colleague, but you will keep the deadline.
cues: Say you still need to coordinate the details with a colleague
Say you will keep the deadline
b1-06-04.target: Még egyeztetnem kell a kollégával a részletekről, de tartani fogjuk a határidőt.
b1-06-04.english: I still need to coordinate the details with my colleague, but we will keep the deadline.
b1-06-04.canDo: I can coordinate tasks and meetings with colleagues using egyeztet.

b1-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Career Plans
b1-06-05.scenario: Gábor asks what you want to achieve in your job in the next years.
b1-06-05.prompt: Say that you would like to gain more experience and build a career.
cues: Say you want to gain more experience
Say you want to build a career
b1-06-05.target: Több tapasztalatot szeretnék szerezni, és karriert építeni.
b1-06-05.english: I would like to gain more experience and build a career.
b1-06-05.canDo: I can discuss my career trajectory and professional development.

b1-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day at the Office
b1-06-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks how the day went at the office.
b1-06-consolidation.prompt: Say that there are many working people in the office and that the problem got solved.
cues: Say that many working people are in the office
Say that the problem got solved
b1-06-consolidation.target: Sok dolgozó ember van az irodában, és a probléma megoldódott.
b1-06-consolidation.english: There are many working people in the office, and the problem got solved.
b1-06-consolidation.canDo: I can form and understand present participles in -ó/-ő and mediopassive verbs in -ódik/-ődik.

b1-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: After Primary School
b1-07-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what students can do after primary school in Hungary. You (Meg) say that they can apply to a grammar school and that they take the school-leaving exam at the end of it.
b1-07-01.prompt: Tell Petra what students can do after primary school and which exam they take at the grammar school.
cues: Say what students can do after primary school
Say which exam they take at the grammar school
b1-07-01.target: Az általános iskola után a diákok gimnáziumba jelentkezhetnek. A gimnáziumban érettségi vizsgát tesznek.
b1-07-01.english: After primary school, students can apply to a grammar school. At the grammar school they take the school-leaving exam.
b1-07-01.canDo: I can explain the main stages of the Hungarian education system.

b1-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Why This Course
b1-07-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she goes to the evening Hungarian course. You (Meg) say that you go so that you can speak Hungarian better at the office.
b1-07-02.prompt: Tell Károly why you attend the course.
cues: Say that you attend the course for a reason
Say what you want to do better at the office
b1-07-02.target: Azért járok erre a tanfolyamra, hogy jobban beszéljek magyarul az irodában.
b1-07-02.english: I attend this course so that I can speak Hungarian better at the office.
b1-07-02.canDo: I can express purpose and goals using azért, hogy + subjunctive.

b1-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering Words
b1-07-03.scenario: Anna tells Meg that she cannot remember the new Hungarian words and that her exam is soon. You (Meg) advise her to concentrate on the exam and to repeat the words every day.
b1-07-03.prompt: Advise Anna what to concentrate on and what to do with the words every day.
cues: Tell Anna what to concentrate on
Tell her what to do with the words every day
b1-07-03.target: Összpontosíts a vizsgára, és ismételd a szavakat minden nap!
b1-07-03.english: Concentrate on the exam and repeat the words every day!
b1-07-03.canDo: I can discuss effective study techniques, focus, and memory.

b1-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Oral Exam
b1-07-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg how her Hungarian oral exam went. You (Meg) say that it went very well, that you got a good grade and that you passed.
b1-07-04.prompt: Tell Petra that the oral exam went well, what grade you got and that you passed.
cues: Say that the exam went very well
Say what kind of grade you got
Say that you passed the oral exam
b1-07-04.target: Nagyon jól sikerült! Jó érdemjegyet kaptam, és átmentem a szóbeli vizsgán.
b1-07-04.english: It went very well! I got a good grade, and I passed the oral exam.
b1-07-04.canDo: I can describe exam preparation, taking an exam, and results.

b1-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning at Any Age
b1-07-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg whether adults can still learn new things. You (Meg) say that people can learn all their lives and that self-study is a good opportunity.
b1-07-05.prompt: Tell Anna that people can learn all their lives and that self-study is a good opportunity.
cues: Say how long people can learn
Say what kind of opportunity self-study is
b1-07-05.target: Az ember élete végéig tanulhat. Az önképzés jó lehetőség.
b1-07-05.english: People can learn all their lives. Self-study is a good opportunity.
b1-07-05.canDo: I can discuss lifelong learning, retraining, and personal development.

b1-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: End of Grammar School
b1-07-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg what happens at the end of grammar school in Hungary. You (Meg) say that the students take the school-leaving exam and can then apply to university.
b1-07-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the students do at the end of grammar school and what they can do after the exam.
cues: Say which exam the students take at the end of grammar school
Say where they can apply after the exam
b1-07-consolidation.target: A gimnázium végén a diákok érettségi vizsgát tesznek. Az érettségi után egyetemre jelentkezhetnek.
b1-07-consolidation.english: At the end of grammar school, the students take the school-leaving exam. After it they can apply to university.
b1-07-consolidation.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian education system and school stages accurately.

b1-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Train to the Balaton
b1-08-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how you get to Lake Balaton on Saturday. You (Meg) have checked the timetable: the train leaves at three and goes without a transfer.
b1-08-01.prompt: Tell Károly when the train leaves according to the timetable and that you can travel to the Balaton without a transfer.
cues: Say when the train leaves according to the timetable
Say that you can travel without a transfer
Say which way the train goes
b1-08-01.target: A menetrend szerint a vonat háromkor indul. Átszállás nélkül utazhatunk a Balaton felé.
b1-08-01.english: According to the timetable, the train leaves at three. We can travel towards Lake Balaton without a transfer.
b1-08-01.canDo: I can navigate public transport schedules, transfers, and destinations.

b1-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Road to the Lake
b1-08-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg which way the road to the lake leads. You (Meg) say that the road leads through a long tunnel and that you cross the bridge on foot.
b1-08-02.prompt: Tell Petra how the road leads to the lake and how you cross the bridge.
cues: Say what the road leads through
Say how you cross the bridge
b1-08-02.target: Az út egy hosszú alagúton keresztül vezet. A hídon gyalog kelünk át.
b1-08-02.english: The road leads through a long tunnel. We cross the bridge on foot.
b1-08-02.canDo: I can describe moving through geographical terrain, tunnels, and passes.

b1-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: As Far as the Balaton
b1-08-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg how far you travel by train on Saturday and how long the trip lasts. You (Meg) say that you travel as far as Lake Balaton and that the trip lasts until the evening.
b1-08-03.prompt: Tell Anna how far you travel and until when the trip lasts.
cues: Say how far you travel by train
Say until when the trip lasts
b1-08-03.target: A Balatonig utazunk vonattal. Az út estig tart.
b1-08-03.english: We travel by train as far as Lake Balaton. The trip lasts until the evening.
b1-08-03.canDo: I can use the terminative case -ig to specify destinations and time limits.

b1-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Late Train
b1-08-04.scenario: Petra phones Meg and asks why you are late. You (Meg) say that because of the delay you missed the train and that a replacement bus will come.
b1-08-04.prompt: Tell Petra why you are late and what is coming instead of the train.
cues: Say why you missed the train
Say what is coming instead of the train
b1-08-04.target: A késés miatt lekéstük a vonatot. Pótlóbusz fog jönni.
b1-08-04.english: Because of the delay, we missed the train. A replacement bus is going to come.
b1-08-04.canDo: I can handle unexpected travel disruptions, missed trains, and delays.

b1-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning the Trip to Eger
b1-08-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the weekend trip to Eger. You (Meg) have already booked the accommodation, and according to the itinerary you spend three days there.
b1-08-05.prompt: Tell Károly that you have booked the accommodation and how many days you spend in Eger.
cues: Say that you booked the accommodation
Say how many days you spend in Eger according to the itinerary
b1-08-05.target: Már foglaltam szállást Egerben. Az útiterv szerint három napot töltünk ott.
b1-08-05.english: I have already booked accommodation in Eger. According to the itinerary, we spend three days there.
b1-08-05.canDo: I can prepare a full travel itinerary, reserve accommodation, and select sights.

b1-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting to Eger
b1-08-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how you get to Eger on Saturday. You (Meg) say that the train goes without a transfer and that you looked at the timetable on the internet.
b1-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the train goes without a transfer and what you looked at on the internet.
cues: Say how the train goes
Say what you looked at on the internet
b1-08-consolidation.target: A vonat átszállás nélkül megy Eger felé. Néztem a menetrendet az interneten.
b1-08-consolidation.english: The train goes towards Eger without a transfer. I looked at the timetable on the internet.
b1-08-consolidation.canDo: I can navigate Hungarian public transit, timetables, and ticket inspections.

b1-09-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Staying Healthy
b1-09-01.scenario: Anna asks Meg what one should do to stay healthy. You (Meg) say that one must drink a lot of water and pay attention to nutrition.
b1-09-01.prompt: Tell Anna what one must drink a lot of and what one must pay attention to.
cues: Say what one must drink a lot of
Say what one must pay attention to
b1-09-01.target: Az embernek sok vizet kell innia. Figyelnie kell a táplálkozásra.
b1-09-01.english: One must drink a lot of water. One must pay attention to nutrition.
b1-09-01.canDo: I can express generalized health advice and truths using az ember.

b1-09-02.title: Communicative Challenge: No Smoking
b1-09-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg in front of the hospital whether she may smoke here. You (Meg) say that unfortunately she may not, because smoking is forbidden in the hospital.
b1-09-02.prompt: Tell Petra that she may not smoke here and why.
cues: Say that it is not allowed
Say that smoking is forbidden in the hospital
b1-09-02.target: Sajnos nem szabad. A kórházban tilos a dohányzás.
b1-09-02.english: Unfortunately it is not allowed. In the hospital, smoking is forbidden.
b1-09-02.canDo: I can express strict prohibitions and permissions using szabad and tilos.

b1-09-03.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Doctor's
b1-09-03.scenario: At the family doctor's, the doctor asks Meg what her complaint is. You (Meg) say that you have a sore throat and a fever.
b1-09-03.prompt: Tell the doctor what you complain of.
cues: Say that you complain of a sore throat
Say that you complain of a fever too
b1-09-03.english: I complain of a sore throat and a fever.
b1-09-03.canDo: I can describe medical symptoms and complaints clearly to a physician.

b1-09-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Winding Down
b1-09-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg how she relieves the daily tension. You (Meg) say that walking helps and that balance between work and private life is important.
b1-09-04.prompt: Tell Petra what helps you relieve tension and what is important.
cues: Say what helps to relieve the tension
Say what balance is important
b1-09-04.target: A séta segít levezetni a feszültséget. Fontos az egyensúly a munka és a magánélet között.
b1-09-04.english: Walking helps to relieve the tension. Balance between work and private life is important.
b1-09-04.canDo: I can discuss stress management, work-life balance, and relaxation.

b1-09-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Advice for a Cold
b1-09-05.scenario: Anna has a cold and asks Meg what she should do. You (Meg) say that it is worth drinking hot tea and that it is recommended to rest a lot.
b1-09-05.prompt: Advise Anna what is worth drinking and what is recommended.
cues: Say what is worth drinking
Say what is recommended
b1-09-05.target: Érdemes forró teát inni. Ajánlott sokat pihenni.
b1-09-05.english: It is worth drinking hot tea. It is recommended to rest a lot.
b1-09-05.canDo: I can offer polite, natural health advice using érdemes and ajánlott.

b1-09-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Advice for a Healthy Life
b1-09-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg for advice for a healthy life. You (Meg) say that one must walk a lot and that smoking is forbidden.
b1-09-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what one must do a lot and what is forbidden.
cues: Say what one must do a lot
Say what is forbidden
b1-09-consolidation.target: Az embernek sokat kell sétálnia. Dohányozni tilos.
b1-09-consolidation.english: One must walk a lot. Smoking is forbidden.
b1-09-consolidation.canDo: I can give natural health advice using generic az ember and modal verbs.

b1-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Making a Room Homely
b1-10-01.scenario: Anna comes to see Meg and Károly's flat. She notices the new lamp in the living room and asks what you did with the small room next to it. You (Meg) say that the new lamp makes the room homely, and that you converted the small room into an office.
b1-10-01.prompt: Tell Anna what the new lamp does and what you made of the small room.
cues: Say what the new lamp makes of the room
Say what you converted the small room into
b1-10-01.target: Az új lámpa otthonossá teszi a szobát. A kis szobát átalakítottuk irodává.
b1-10-01.english: The new lamp makes the room homely. We converted the small room into an office.
b1-10-01.canDo: I can express transformation and change of state using the translative case -vá / -vé.

b1-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Flat
b1-10-02.scenario: Anna has not seen Meg and Károly's flat yet and asks what it is like. You (Meg) say that you have a balcony where you drink coffee in the morning, and that the flat on the second floor is comfortable.
b1-10-02.prompt: Tell Anna about the balcony and about the flat.
cues: Say what you have and what you do there in the morning
Say where the flat is and that it is comfortable
b1-10-02.target: Van egy erkélyünk, ahol reggel kávét iszunk. A lakás, amely a második emeleten van, nagyon kényelmes.
b1-10-02.english: We have a balcony where we drink coffee in the morning. The flat, which is on the second floor, is very comfortable.
b1-10-02.canDo: I can describe a home with relative clauses (amely, ami, ahol).

b1-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Lease Says
b1-10-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the lease says about the money. You (Meg) tell him that you are obliged to pay the utilities every month and that you have no choice but to pay a two-month deposit.
b1-10-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you are obliged to pay every month and what you have no choice but to pay now.
cues: Say what you are obliged to pay every month
Say what you have no choice but to pay now
