b1-10-03.target: Kötelesek vagyunk havonta fizetni a rezsit. Kénytelenek vagyunk két havi kauciót fizetni.
b1-10-03.english: We are obliged to pay the utilities every month. We have no choice but to pay a two-month deposit.
b1-10-03.canDo: I can say what someone is obliged to do, using köteles and kénytelen.

b1-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Does the Table Go?
b1-10-04.scenario: Károly and Meg are arranging the living room, and Károly asks where the small table and the shelf should go. You (Meg) say that the sofa is by the wall, the small table goes in front of it and the shelf above it.
b1-10-04.prompt: Tell Károly where the sofa is, and what goes in front of it and above it.
cues: Say where the sofa is
Say what goes in front of it
Say what goes above it
b1-10-04.target: A kanapé a fal mellett van, előtte van egy kis asztal, fölötte pedig egy polc.
b1-10-04.english: The sofa is by the wall, in front of it is a small table, and above it is a shelf.
b1-10-04.canDo: I can describe the layout and arrangement of furniture in an apartment.

b1-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Matters in a Home
b1-10-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg what is important to her and Károly in a home. You (Meg) say that it is important that the flat is quiet and bright, and that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-05.prompt: Tell Anna what is important to you in a home.
cues: Say that it matters that the flat is quiet and bright
Say what matters about the heating
b1-10-05.target: Fontos, hogy a lakás csendes és világos legyen. Nekem az a fontos, hogy a fűtés olcsó legyen.
b1-10-05.english: It is important that the flat is quiet and bright. What matters to me is that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-05.canDo: I can say what matters to me in a home, using Fontos, hogy ...

b1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Changes at Home
b1-10-consolidation.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she and Károly are doing with the flat this autumn. You (Meg) say that you are turning the small room into an office, and that it is important that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna what you are doing with the small room and what matters about the heating.
cues: Say what you are turning the small room into
Say what matters about the heating
b1-10-consolidation.target: A kis szobát átalakítjuk irodává. Fontos, hogy a fűtés olcsó legyen.
b1-10-consolidation.english: We are turning the small room into an office. It is important that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can use the translative case -vá / -vé to describe home improvements.

b1-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Neighbourhood We Live In
b1-11-01.scenario: Károly's mother, Ildikó, asks Meg what the neighbourhood is like where she and Károly live. You (Meg) say that the neighbourhood in which you live is very quiet, and that there are many parks, which is very good.
b1-11-01.prompt: Tell Ildikó what the neighbourhood in which you live is like and what you think about the parks.
cues: Say that the neighbourhood where you live is quiet
Say there are many parks and that you think this is good
b1-11-01.target: A környék, amelyben lakunk, nagyon csendes. Sok park van, ami nagyon jó.
b1-11-01.english: The neighbourhood in which we live is very quiet. There are many parks, which is very good.
b1-11-01.canDo: I can describe a town and its people with relative pronouns (amelyben, akinek, amiről, ahová).

b1-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Street Party
b1-11-02.scenario: Károly's father, Gábor, asks Meg who comes to the street party in her neighbourhood. You (Meg) say that the people of the neighbourhood organize a joint celebration every year, and that everybody helps.
b1-11-02.prompt: Tell Gábor who organizes the celebration and how often, and that everybody helps.
cues: Say who organizes the joint celebration and how often
Say that everybody helps
b1-11-02.target: A környékbeli emberek minden évben közös ünnepet szerveznek. Mindenki segít.
b1-11-02.english: The people of the neighbourhood organize a joint celebration every year. Everybody helps.
b1-11-02.canDo: I can form adjectives with -beli to say where people or things are from (falubeli, helybeli).

b1-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: City or Village?
b1-11-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she would rather live in the city or in a village. You (Meg) say that in the city there is a lot of work, but in the countryside, however, life is quieter.
b1-11-03.prompt: Tell Károly what is good about the city and then contrast it with the countryside.
cues: Say what there is a lot of in the city
Contrast it with life in the countryside
b1-11-03.target: A városban sok a munka. Vidéken azonban csendesebb az élet.
b1-11-03.english: In the city there is a lot of work. In the countryside, however, life is quieter.
b1-11-03.canDo: I can contrast two things with azonban, viszont and ezzel szemben.

b1-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What to See in Szeged
b1-11-04.scenario: Petra is going to Szeged for a weekend, where Meg and Károly stayed in a hotel, and asks Meg what to visit. You (Meg) say that it is definitely worth visiting the church in Szeged, and that if she can, she should also go to the river.
b1-11-04.prompt: Tell Petra what is definitely worth visiting in Szeged and what she should also do if she can.
cues: Say what is definitely worth visiting in Szeged
Say where she should go too, if she can
b1-11-04.target: Szegeden mindenképpen érdemes meglátogatni a templomot. Ha teheted, menj el a Tiszához is.
b1-11-04.english: In Szeged it is definitely worth visiting the church. If you can, go to the Tisza too.
b1-11-04.canDo: I can recommend tourist destinations, sights, and hospitality venues in Hungary.

b1-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Taking Part
b1-11-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she is taking part in the neighbourhood programme on Saturday. You (Meg) say that you take part in the programme, and that you trust your friend, who organizes it.
b1-11-05.prompt: Tell Károly that you take part in the programme and that you trust your friend.
cues: Say that you take part in the programme
Say that you trust your friend
b1-11-05.target: Részt veszek a programban. Bízom a barátomban.
b1-11-05.english: I am taking part in the programme. I trust my friend.
b1-11-05.canDo: I can say what I take part in, trust or believe in, with verbs that take -ban/-ben.

b1-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: City and Village
b1-11-consolidation.scenario: Gábor asks Meg what the city where she works is like compared with a village. You (Meg) say that the city in which you work is very busy, and that in the village, on the other hand, life is quiet.
b1-11-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gábor what the city in which you work is like, then say how the village is different.
cues: Say that the city where you work is busy
Say what the village is like instead
b1-11-consolidation.target: A város, amelyben dolgozom, nagyon forgalmas. A faluban viszont csendes az élet.
b1-11-consolidation.english: The city in which I work is very busy. In the village, on the other hand, life is quiet.
b1-11-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a town with relative pronouns such as amelyben and amiről.

b1-12-01.title: Communicative Challenge: When Is the Soup Ready?
b1-12-01.scenario: Meg is helping Károly's mother, Ildikó, cook the family gulyás. Ildikó asks when the dish will be ready. You (Meg) say that the soup is cooked in two hours and that the meat becomes soft in an hour.
b1-12-01.prompt: Tell Ildikó when the soup is cooked and when the meat becomes soft.
cues: Say how long it takes for the soup to be cooked
Say how long it takes for the meat to become soft
b1-12-01.target: A leves két óra alatt megfő. A hús egy óra alatt megpuhul.
b1-12-01.english: The soup is cooked in two hours. The meat becomes soft in an hour.
b1-12-01.canDo: I can describe cooking and baking processes using mediopassive verbs (megfő, megsül, megpuhul).

b1-12-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Eat
b1-12-02.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how often she eats vegetables and fruit. You (Meg) say that you eat vegetables regularly and fruit twice a day.
b1-12-02.prompt: Tell Ildikó how often you eat vegetables and fruit.
cues: Say that you eat vegetables regularly
Say how many times a day you eat fruit
b1-12-02.target: Rendszeresen eszem zöldséget. Naponta kétszer eszem gyümölcsöt.
b1-12-02.english: I regularly eat vegetables. I eat fruit twice a day.
b1-12-02.canDo: I can say how often I do something with rendszeresen, naponta, időnként and ritkán.

b1-12-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Ildikó's Gulyás, Step by Step
b1-12-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg how to start Ildikó's gulyás, which she learned in his mother's kitchen. You (Meg) say that first you cut up the onion, then you add the meat and the paprika.
b1-12-03.prompt: Tell Károly the first two steps of the gulyás.
cues: Say what you do first
Say what you add next
b1-12-03.target: Először vágjuk fel a hagymát, majd adjuk hozzá a húst és a paprikát.
b1-12-03.english: First we cut up the onion, then we add the meat and the paprika.
b1-12-03.canDo: I can put the steps of a recipe in order with először, majd, miután and végül.

b1-12-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Real Hungarikum
b1-12-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg which Hungarian food she likes most. You (Meg) say that goulash is a real hungarikum and that it is spicy.
b1-12-04.prompt: Tell Petra what you think is a real hungarikum and how it tastes.
cues: Say which dish is a real hungarikum
Say how it tastes
b1-12-04.target: A gulyás igazi hungarikum. Nagyon fűszeres.
b1-12-04.english: Goulash is a real hungarikum. It is very spicy.
b1-12-04.canDo: I can say what a hungarikum is and name one.

b1-12-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Asking for the Bill
b1-12-05.scenario: Meg and Károly have finished dinner in a restaurant. You (Meg) call the waiter, politely ask him to bring the bill, and say that you pay by card.
b1-12-05.prompt: Ask the waiter politely for the bill and say how you pay.
cues: Ask the waiter politely to bring the bill
Say that you pay by card
b1-12-05.target: Legyen szíves, hozna a számlát? Kártyával fizetünk.
b1-12-05.english: Could you please bring the bill? We pay by card.
b1-12-05.canDo: I can interact politely with restaurant staff, order multi-course meals, and request the bill.

b1-12-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Cooked
b1-12-consolidation.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg what you did first in the kitchen today. You (Meg) say that first you cut up the onion, and that the meat became soft in an hour.
b1-12-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ildikó what you did first and what happened to the meat.
cues: Say what you did first
Say what happened to the meat
b1-12-consolidation.target: Először felvágtuk a hagymát, majd a hús egy óra alatt megpuhult.
b1-12-consolidation.english: First we cut up the onion, then the meat became soft in an hour.
b1-12-consolidation.canDo: I can describe food cooking processes using mediopassive verbs.

b1-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Spokesperson Said
b1-13-01.scenario: Károly missed the evening news. You (Meg) watched it: the spokesperson said that the minister arrives tomorrow.
b1-13-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the spokesperson said.
cues: Say that the spokesperson said something
Say that the minister arrives tomorrow
b1-13-01.target: A szóvivő azt mondta, hogy a miniszter holnap érkezik.
b1-13-01.english: The spokesperson said that the minister arrives tomorrow.
b1-13-01.canDo: I can report what someone said using azt mondta, hogy.

b1-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Reporter Asked
b1-13-02.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) what happened at the press conference. A reporter asked whether the news is true, and the spokesperson confirmed it.
b1-13-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the reporter asked and what the spokesperson did.
cues: Say what the reporter asked
Say that the spokesperson confirmed it
b1-13-02.target: A tudósító azt kérdezte, hogy igaz-e a hír. A szóvivő megerősítette.
b1-13-02.english: The reporter asked whether the news is true. The spokesperson confirmed it.
b1-13-02.canDo: I can report a question using azt kérdezte, hogy and -e.

b1-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Is the Photo Real?
b1-13-03.scenario: Petra shows you (Meg) a photo online. People say it is genuine, but you are not sure that the news about it is true.
b1-13-03.prompt: Tell Petra that the photo is allegedly genuine, but that you doubt the news.
cues: Say that the photo is allegedly genuine
Say that it is doubtful whether the news is true
b1-13-03.target: Állítólag a fénykép valódi, de kétséges, hogy igaz a hír.
b1-13-03.english: Allegedly the photo is genuine, but it is doubtful whether the news is true.
b1-13-03.canDo: I can show that news is only hearsay using állítólag and úgy tűnik.

b1-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Truth Came Out
b1-13-04.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) how the story about the accident ended. After the investigation, it turned out that the news was not true.
b1-13-04.prompt: Tell Petra how the story ended and how people reacted.
cues: Say that it turned out after the investigation that the news is not true
Say that public opinion calmed down
b1-13-04.target: A nyomozás után kiderült, hogy a hír nem igaz. A közvélemény megnyugodott.
b1-13-04.english: After the investigation it turned out that the news is not true. Public opinion calmed down.
b1-13-04.canDo: I can say that the truth came out using kiderült, hogy.

b1-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of Online News
b1-13-05.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) what you think about online news in an op-ed discussion at home.
b1-13-05.prompt: Tell Petra the two sides of online news: it is fast, but there is a lot of fake news.
cues: Say that on the one hand the internet is fast
Say that on the other hand there is a lot of fake news
b1-13-05.target: Egyfelől gyors az internet, másfelől sok az álhír.
b1-13-05.english: On the one hand the internet is fast, on the other hand there is a lot of fake news.
b1-13-05.canDo: I can balance two points of view using egyfelől … másfelől.

b1-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Check the Source
b1-13-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) whether the news is true. The spokesperson said it is not, and you always check the news source.
b1-13-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the spokesperson said, and what you always check.
cues: Say that according to the spokesperson the news is not true
Say that you always check the news source
b1-13-consolidation.target: A szóvivő szerint a hír nem igaz. Én mindig ellenőrzöm a hírforrást.
b1-13-consolidation.english: According to the spokesperson, the news is not true. I always check the news source.
b1-13-consolidation.canDo: I can report what someone said and check where news comes from.

b1-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Problems to Solve
b1-14-01.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) how things are at the company where Petra works. You say that there are many problems to be solved there today.
b1-14-01.prompt: Tell Károly that there are many problems to be solved at the company today.
cues: Say that there are many problems today
Say that they are problems to be solved
b1-14-01.target: A cégnél ma sok a megoldandó probléma.
b1-14-01.english: There are many problems to be solved at the company today.
b1-14-01.canDo: I can describe a task that still has to be done using -andó / -endő.

b1-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Upload the Document
b1-14-02.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) what she should do with a document so that everyone on the network can see it. You tell her to upload it.
b1-14-02.prompt: Ask Petra politely to upload the document to the network.
cues: Ask her politely to do something
Say that she should upload the document to the network
b1-14-02.target: Kérlek, töltsd fel a dokumentumot a hálózatra!
b1-14-02.english: Please upload the document to the network!
b1-14-02.canDo: I can use verb prefixes like fel- and le- in tech phrases such as feltölt and letölt.

b1-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Less Screen Time
b1-14-03.scenario: Petra worries that her little brother spends too much time on his phone. You (Meg) say that for the sake of children's health, one should limit screen time.
b1-14-03.prompt: Tell Petra what to do for the sake of the children's health.
cues: Say that it is for the sake of the children's health
Say that screen time must be limited
b1-14-03.target: A gyerekek egészsége érdekében korlátozzuk a képernyőidőt.
b1-14-03.english: For the sake of the children's health, let us limit screen time.
b1-14-03.canDo: I can give formal advice using érdekében, like a biztonság érdekében.

b1-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Update the App
b1-14-04.scenario: Your older neighbour asks you (Meg) how to update an app on her phone. You answer politely, addressing her as Ön.
b1-14-04.prompt: Tell your neighbour politely to open the settings and update the app.
cues: Tell her to open the settings
Tell her to update the app
b1-14-04.target: Nyissa meg a beállításokat, és frissítse az alkalmazást!
b1-14-04.english: Open the settings and update the app!
b1-14-04.canDo: I can give a polite instruction using forms like Nyissa meg.

b1-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Then and Now
b1-14-05.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) how friends kept in touch in the past and how they do it today. You say that earlier people wrote letters, while today they send messages.
b1-14-05.prompt: Tell Károly how it was earlier and how it is today.
cues: Say what people did earlier
Say what people do today
b1-14-05.target: Míg korábban levelet írtunk, addig ma üzenetet küldünk.
b1-14-05.english: While earlier we wrote letters, today we send messages.
b1-14-05.canDo: I can contrast then and now with míg … addig.

b1-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Apps and Users
b1-14-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) about the new app. You say that every user likes it and that data protection is important.
b1-14-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what every user likes and what is important.
cues: Say that every user likes the app
Say that data protection is important
b1-14-consolidation.target: Minden felhasználó szereti ezt az alkalmazást. Fontos az adatvédelem.
b1-14-consolidation.english: Every user likes this app. Data protection is important.
b1-14-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about apps, users and data protection in a few sentences.

b1-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: More Concerts, More Music
b1-15-01.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) why you go to so many concerts. You say that the more concerts you go to, the more you like music.
b1-15-01.prompt: Tell Petra how going to concerts changes how much you like music.
cues: Say that you go to more concerts
Say that you like music better because of it
b1-15-01.target: Minél többet járok koncertre, annál jobban szeretem a zenét.
b1-15-01.english: The more I go to concerts, the more I like music.
b1-15-01.canDo: I can say that one thing grows with another using minél … annál ….

b1-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Saturday Concert
b1-15-02.scenario: Károly wants to go out on Saturday and asks you (Meg) for an idea. You recommend the Saturday concert and say that it would be a pity to miss it.
b1-15-02.prompt: Recommend the Saturday concert to Károly.
cues: Say that it is worth going to the concert
Say that it would be a pity to miss it
b1-15-02.target: Érdemes elmenni a szombati koncertre, kár lenne kihagyni!
b1-15-02.english: It is worth going to Saturday's concert; it would be a pity to miss it!
b1-15-02.canDo: I can recommend something using érdemes and kár lenne kihagyni.

b1-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long but Good Film
b1-15-03.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) about the film you saw yesterday. You say that although the film was long, everyone liked it, and that the lead actor was very good.
b1-15-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you thought of the film.
cues: Say that the film was long, but everyone liked it
Say that the lead actor was very good
b1-15-03.target: Bár a film hosszú volt, mindenkinek tetszett. A főszereplő nagyon jól játszott.
b1-15-03.english: Although the film was long, everyone liked it. The lead actor acted very well.
b1-15-03.canDo: I can balance praise and criticism with bár or noha.

b1-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Recognized Festival
b1-15-04.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) whether the summer festival is well known. You say that it is a very recognized festival and part of the cultural heritage.
b1-15-04.prompt: Tell Petra how well known the festival is.
cues: Say that it is a very recognized festival
Say that it is part of the cultural heritage
b1-15-04.target: Ez egy nagyon elismert fesztivál, és a magyar kulturális örökség része.
b1-15-04.english: This is a very recognized festival, and part of Hungarian cultural heritage.
b1-15-04.canDo: I can describe a person or work as recognized using elismert and similar participles.

b1-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Close to My Heart
b1-15-05.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) about your taste in music. You say that Hungarian music is very close to your heart.
b1-15-05.prompt: Tell Károly what music is close to your heart.
cues: Say which music you mean
Say that it is very close to your heart
b1-15-05.target: A magyar zene nagyon közel áll a szívemhez.
b1-15-05.english: Hungarian music is very close to my heart.
b1-15-05.canDo: I can say that something is close to my heart or alien to me with közel áll and távol áll.

b1-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Best Concert
b1-15-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) about yesterday's concert. You say that it was the best concert you have ever seen and that everyone liked it.
b1-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what you thought of the concert.
cues: Say that it was the best concert you have ever seen
Say that everyone liked it
b1-15-consolidation.target: Ez volt a legjobb koncert, amit valaha láttam. Mindenkinek tetszett.
b1-15-consolidation.english: This was the best concert I have ever seen. Everyone liked it.
b1-15-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about a concert, a film and my taste in a few sentences.

b1-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why My Own Bag
b1-16-01.scenario: Petra sees Meg's own shopping bag at the office and asks why she uses it. You (Meg) say that there is a lot of plastic waste, so you use your own bag, and that we all have to do a lot for environmental protection.
b1-16-01.prompt: Tell Petra why you use your own bag and what we have to do.
cues: Say that there is a lot of plastic waste and what follows from it
Say that we have to do a lot for environmental protection
b1-16-01.target: Sok a műanyaghulladék, ezért saját szatyrot használok. Sokat kell tennünk a környezetvédelemért.
b1-16-01.english: There is a lot of plastic waste, so I use my own bag. We have to do a lot for environmental protection.
b1-16-01.canDo: I can say why something happens with mert and what follows with ezért.

b1-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: More Storms
b1-16-02.scenario: Károly reads that the weather is changing and asks Meg why there are so many storms this summer. You (Meg) say that because of climate change there are more storms, as a result of which there is a lot of trouble, and that because of this we have to take care of nature.
b1-16-02.prompt: Tell Károly why there are more storms and what follows from it.
cues: Say what causes the storms and what comes of it
Say what we have to do because of this
b1-16-02.target: A klímaváltozás miatt több a vihar, aminek következtében sok a baj. Emiatt vigyáznunk kell a természetre.
b1-16-02.english: Because of climate change there are more storms, as a result of which there is a lot of trouble. Because of this we have to take care of nature.
b1-16-02.canDo: I can say that one thing leads to another with emiatt and aminek következtében.

b1-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: If the Water Is Dirty
b1-16-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she thinks will happen to a small river near the city if nobody takes care of it. You (Meg) say that if the water is dirty the fish are ill, and that because of deforestation the forest disappears.
b1-16-03.prompt: Tell Anna what happens to the fish and to the forest.
cues: Say what happens to the fish if the water is dirty
Say what happens to the forest because of deforestation
b1-16-03.target: Ha piszkos a víz, a halak betegek. Az erdőirtás miatt eltűnik az erdő.
b1-16-03.english: If the water is dirty, the fish are ill. Because of deforestation the forest disappears.
b1-16-03.canDo: I can say what happens if we do or do not take care of nature, using ha.

b1-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why We Recycle
b1-16-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg why people recycle. You (Meg) say that recycling is important for nature, and that we recycle so that nature stays clean.
b1-16-04.prompt: Tell Károly why recycling matters and what we recycle for.
cues: Say that recycling is important for nature
Say why we recycle
b1-16-04.target: Az újrahasznosítás fontos a természetnek. Azért újrahasznosítunk, hogy tiszta maradjon a természet.
b1-16-04.english: Recycling is important for nature. We recycle so that nature stays clean.
b1-16-04.canDo: I can turn a verb into a noun with -ás or -és, like újrahasznosítás.

b1-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Usually Do
b1-16-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she usually does for the environment. You (Meg) say that you usually buy from local producers, and that in your opinion waste reduction is important.
b1-16-05.prompt: Tell Petra where you usually buy things and what you think is important.
cues: Say what you usually do
Say what you think is important
b1-16-05.target: Helyi termelőktől szoktam vásárolni. Véleményem szerint a hulladékcsökkentés fontos.
b1-16-05.english: I usually buy from local producers. In my opinion waste reduction is important.
b1-16-05.canDo: I can say what I usually do for nature with szokott + infinitive.

b1-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Walk in the Park
b1-16-consolidation.scenario: Anna and Meg are walking in the park, and Anna asks Meg what she does for the environment. You (Meg) say that you recycle because there is a lot of plastic waste, and that we have to take care of the water so that it stays clean.
b1-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna what you do and why, and what we have to take care of.
cues: Say what you do and why
Say what we have to take care of and what for
b1-16-consolidation.target: Újrahasznosítok, mert sok a műanyaghulladék. Vigyáznunk kell a vízre, hogy tiszta maradjon.
b1-16-consolidation.english: I recycle because there is a lot of plastic waste. We have to take care of the water so that it stays clean.
b1-16-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about the environment: why things happen, what we have to do and what I do myself.

b1-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Role or Comparison
b1-17-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why she is still at the office late in the evening. You (Meg) say that as a colleague you want to help, and that today you are working like a machine.
b1-17-01.prompt: Tell Petra in what role you want to help and how you work today.
cues: Say in what role you want to help
Say how you work today, as a comparison
b1-17-01.target: Kollégaként segíteni akarok. Ma úgy dolgozom, mint egy gép.
b1-17-01.english: As a colleague I want to help. Today I'm working like a machine.
b1-17-01.canDo: I can tell -ként (a role) from mint (a comparison).

b1-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Per Family
b1-17-02.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she read in the news about support for families. You (Meg) say that the support is calculated per family, and that in the cities there is a lot of work, in contrast to the countryside.
b1-17-02.prompt: Tell Anna how the support is calculated and what the work is like in the cities and in the countryside.
cues: Say how the support is calculated
Contrast the cities with the countryside
b1-17-02.target: A támogatást családonként számolják ki. A városokban sok a munka, ezzel szemben vidéken kevés.
b1-17-02.english: The support is calculated per family. In the cities there is a lot of work, in contrast to the countryside there is little.
b1-17-02.canDo: I can say how much or how often per person, family or group with -nként.

b1-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Fair for Children
b1-17-03.scenario: Petra says that some people find the school system unfair. You (Meg) say that it is fair for every child to get a good education, and that people in need receive welfare aid.
b1-17-03.prompt: Tell Petra what is fair and who receives welfare aid.
cues: Say what is fair for every child
Say who receives welfare aid
b1-17-03.target: Igazságos, hogy minden gyerek jó oktatást kapjon. A rászorulók segélyben részesülnek.
b1-17-03.english: It is fair that every child gets a good education. People in need receive welfare aid.
b1-17-03.canDo: I can say that something is fair or unfair with igazságos and méltányos and hogy + -jon/-jen.

b1-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Organisations
b1-17-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg which civil organisations she thinks do a good job. You (Meg) say that those organisations are good that help people in need, and that the helping volunteers do a lot for the community.
b1-17-04.prompt: Tell Károly which organisations you mean and what the volunteers do.
cues: Say which organisations are good
Say what the helping volunteers do
b1-17-04.target: Azok a civil szervezetek jók, amelyek segítenek a rászorulóknak. A segítő önkéntesek sokat tesznek a közösségért.
b1-17-04.english: Those civil organisations are good that help people in need. The helping volunteers do a lot for the community.
b1-17-04.canDo: I can say which organizations or programs do something, with azok a … amelyek and olyan … amelyek.

b1-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How I See the Future
b1-17-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg how she sees the future of society. You (Meg) say that as you see it, social dialogue is important, and that you trust that future generations will get more equal chances.
b1-17-05.prompt: Tell Anna what you think is important and what you trust.
cues: Say what you think is important
Say what you trust about future generations
b1-17-05.target: Úgy látom, hogy a társadalmi párbeszéd fontos. Bízom benne, hogy a jövő generációi egyenlőbb esélyeket kapnak.
b1-17-05.english: As I see it, social dialogue is important. I trust that future generations will get more equal chances.
b1-17-05.canDo: I can give my view with úgy látom, hogy and véleményem szerint.

b1-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Helping the Village
b1-17-consolidation.scenario: Károly tells Meg about a village where many families are in need. You (Meg) say that the volunteers help the families in need, and that voluntary work is important for the community.
b1-17-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the volunteers do and why voluntary work matters.
cues: Say who helps the families in need
Say why voluntary work matters
b1-17-consolidation.target: Az önkéntesek segítenek a rászoruló családoknak. Az önkéntes munka fontos a közösségnek.
b1-17-consolidation.english: The volunteers help families in need. Voluntary work is important for the community.
b1-17-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about fairness, help and living together in society.

b1-18-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Voting Late
b1-18-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she saw on the news about the parliament last night. You (Meg) say that although it was late in the evening, the representatives continued the voting.
b1-18-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the representatives did in spite of the late hour.
cues: Say what the late hour did not stop
Say who continued what
b1-18-01.target: Annak ellenére, hogy késő este volt, a képviselők folytatták a szavazást.
b1-18-01.english: Although it was late in the evening, the representatives continued the voting.
b1-18-01.canDo: I can say what happened in spite of something, with annak ellenére, hogy and bár.

b1-18-02.title: Communicative Challenge: In Vain
b1-18-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to the proposal she read about at lunch. You (Meg) say that the representatives argued in vain, and that the proposal was not adopted.
b1-18-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the representatives did in vain and what happened to the proposal.
cues: Say that the arguing was in vain
Say what happened to the proposal
b1-18-02.target: Hiába érveltek a képviselők, a javaslatot nem fogadták el.
b1-18-02.english: No matter how much the representatives argued, the proposal was not adopted.
b1-18-02.canDo: I can say that an effort was in vain with hiába.

b1-18-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Agreement at Last
b1-18-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg how the long public debate ended. You (Meg) say that the groups finally reached an agreement and that both sides had to make concessions.
b1-18-03.prompt: Tell Anna how the debate ended.
cues: Say that the groups reached an agreement
Say what both sides had to do
b1-18-03.target: A frakciók végül megállapodásra jutottak. Mindkét oldalnak engedményeket kellett tennie.
b1-18-03.english: The groups finally reached an agreement. Both sides had to make concessions.
b1-18-03.canDo: I can say that parties reach an agreement or make a concession, with megállapodásra jut and engedményt tesz.

b1-18-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights and Duties
b1-18-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what a citizen may and must do. You (Meg) say that every citizen has the right to take part in the elections, and that it is a citizen's duty to keep the laws.
b1-18-04.prompt: Tell Károly what a citizen has the right to do and what is a duty.
cues: Say what a citizen has the right to do
Say what a citizen's duty is
b1-18-04.target: Minden állampolgárnak joga van ahhoz, hogy részt vegyen a választásokon. Kötelessége, hogy betartsa a törvényeket.
b1-18-04.english: Every citizen has the right to take part in the elections. It is their duty to keep the laws.
b1-18-04.canDo: I can say what rights and duties citizens have, with joga van ahhoz, hogy and kötelessége, hogy.

b1-18-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Talk
b1-18-05.scenario: At a residents' meeting Petra asks Meg to say a few words about a proposal in the news. You (Meg) open your short talk, say that you agree with the proposal, and close by saying that there is still a debate about the details.
b1-18-05.prompt: Give Petra's meeting your short talk.
cues: Open the talk
Say that you agree with the proposal
Close the talk with what is still open
b1-18-05.target: Elöljáróban szeretném elmondani, hogy egyetértek a javaslattal. Végezetül: a részletekben még vita van.
b1-18-05.english: First of all, I would like to say that I agree with the proposal. Finally: on the details there is still debate.
b1-18-05.canDo: I can open and close a short talk with elöljáróban and végezetül.

b1-18-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Funny Speech
b1-18-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the election speech in the story she has read. You (Meg) say that the candidate promised a bridge, and that the people laughed but said that the work is theirs.
b1-18-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the candidate promised and how the people reacted.
cues: Say what the candidate promised
Say how the people reacted
b1-18-consolidation.target: A jelölt hidat ígért. Az emberek nevettek, de azt mondták, hogy a munka az övék.
b1-18-consolidation.english: The candidate promised a bridge. The people laughed, but said that the work is theirs.
b1-18-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about parliament, elections and citizens' rights in a few sentences.

b1-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Family Budget
b1-19-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the two of them manage their money at home. You (Meg) say that your monthly income is a hundred thousand forints and that you save twenty thousand forints a month.
b1-19-01.prompt: Tell Károly how much your monthly income is and how much you save.
cues: Say how much your monthly income is
Say how much you save each month
b1-19-01.target: A havi bevételünk százezer forint. Havonta húszezer forintot megtakarítunk.
b1-19-01.english: Our monthly income is a hundred thousand forints. We save twenty thousand forints a month.
b1-19-01.canDo: I can talk about a budget: income, expenses and savings.

b1-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Bank Account
b1-19-02.scenario: At the bank, the clerk asks Meg what she needs. You (Meg) say that you would like to open a new bank account and ask what the interest rate is.
b1-19-02.prompt: Tell the clerk what you would like to do and ask about the interest rate.
cues: Say that you want to open a new bank account
Ask how high the interest rate is
b1-19-02.target: Új bankszámlát szeretnék nyitni. Mennyi a kamatláb?
b1-19-02.english: I would like to open a new bank account. What is the interest rate?
b1-19-02.canDo: I can talk about bank accounts, transfers, loans and interest rates.

b1-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Inflation and Prices
b1-19-03.scenario: Károly says that everything is getting more expensive in the shops. You (Meg) answer that the higher inflation is, the more expensive everything is.
b1-19-03.prompt: Tell Károly how inflation and prices are linked.
cues: Say that inflation is higher and link it to prices
Say that everything is more expensive in step with it
b1-19-03.target: Minél magasabb az infláció, annál drágább minden.
b1-19-03.english: The higher inflation is, the more expensive everything is.
b1-19-03.canDo: I can talk about inflation, price rises and exchange rates.

b1-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Starting a Small Business
b1-19-04.scenario: Károly wants to start a small business and asks Meg for advice. You (Meg) say that it is worth writing a business plan first because then the profit is bigger, and that a business needs a good budget.
b1-19-04.prompt: Give Károly advice about the business plan, the profit and the budget.
cues: Say what is worth doing first
Give the reason: the profit
Say what a business needs
b1-19-04.target: Először érdemes üzleti tervet írni, mert akkor nagyobb a nyereség. Egy vállalkozásnak jó költségvetés kell.
b1-19-04.english: First it is worth writing a business plan, because then the profit is bigger. A business needs a good budget.
b1-19-04.canDo: I can talk about starting a business: profit, investment and the business plan.

b1-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Unemployment and Purchasing Power
b1-19-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she read about the economy. You (Meg) say that the lower unemployment is, the higher purchasing power is.
b1-19-05.prompt: Tell Petra how unemployment and purchasing power are linked.
cues: Say that unemployment is lower
Link it to higher purchasing power
b1-19-05.target: Minél kisebb a munkanélküliség, annál nagyobb a vásárlóerő.
b1-19-05.english: The lower unemployment is, the higher purchasing power is.
b1-19-05.canDo: I can talk about the national economy: growth, unemployment and purchasing power.

b1-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gentleman and the Bank
b1-19-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Garanvölgyi úr and the bank is about. You (Meg) say that Garanvölgyi úr asks for a loan but has no money, and that for Pálffy Menyhért work and savings are important.
b1-19-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Garanvölgyi úr wants and what Pálffy Menyhért thinks is important.
cues: Say what Garanvölgyi úr asks for and that he has no money
Say what is important for Pálffy Menyhért
b1-19-consolidation.target: Garanvölgyi úr hitelt kér, de nincs pénze. Pálffy Menyhértnek a munka és a megtakarítás fontos.
b1-19-consolidation.english: Garanvölgyi úr asks for a loan, but he has no money. For Pálffy Menyhért, work and savings are important.
b1-19-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about money and a loan in a few sentences.

b1-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Mistake at Work
b1-20-01.scenario: Károly made a mistake at work and a client is angry. You (Meg) say that if he had said so in time, you would have avoided the mistake.
b1-20-01.prompt: Tell Károly what would have happened if he had spoken in time.
cues: Say what he should have done in time
Say what you would have avoided
b1-20-01.target: Ha időben szóltál volna, elkerültük volna a hibát.
b1-20-01.english: If you had said so in time, we would have avoided the mistake.
b1-20-01.canDo: I can say what would have happened if things had been different, using ha … volna.

b1-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Question for the Boss
b1-20-02.scenario: Petra tells Meg that she forgot to ask the boss about her holiday. You (Meg) say that she should have asked the boss.
b1-20-02.prompt: Tell Petra what she should have done.
cues: Say that she should have asked
Say who she should have asked
b1-20-02.target: Meg kellett volna kérdezned a főnököt.
b1-20-02.english: You should have asked the boss.
b1-20-02.canDo: I can say what should have been done, using kellett volna.

b1-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Way Out of the Difficulty
b1-20-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the project went. You (Meg) say that there were many obstacles, but finally you managed to solve the difficulty.
b1-20-03.prompt: Tell Károly about the obstacles and the result.
cues: Say that there were many obstacles
Say that in the end you managed to solve the difficulty
b1-20-03.target: Sok akadály volt, de végül sikerült megoldanunk a nehézséget.
b1-20-03.english: There were many obstacles, but in the end we managed to solve the difficulty.
b1-20-03.canDo: I can say that we managed to overcome a difficulty, using sikerült.

b1-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Learned
b1-20-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she learned from her mistake at work. You (Meg) say that you drew the lesson that you should have paid more attention to the advice.
b1-20-04.prompt: Tell Petra what lesson you drew from your mistake.
cues: Say that you drew a lesson from the mistake
Say what you should have paid more attention to
b1-20-04.target: A hibából azt a tanulságot vontam le, hogy jobban kellett volna figyelnem a tanácsra.
b1-20-04.english: From the mistake I drew the lesson that I should have paid more attention to the advice.
b1-20-04.canDo: I can say what a mistake taught us.

b1-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Another Alternative
b1-20-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she would suggest for the problem. You (Meg) say that this proposal is not good and that you suggest looking at another alternative.
b1-20-05.prompt: Tell Károly what you think of the proposal and what you suggest.
cues: Say that this proposal is not good
Suggest looking at another alternative
b1-20-05.target: Ez a javaslat nem jó. Azt javaslom, hogy nézzünk meg egy másik alternatívát.
b1-20-05.english: This proposal is not good. I suggest that we look at another alternative.
b1-20-05.canDo: I can talk about proposals, alternatives and results.

b1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Student and the Report Card
b1-20-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about the student and his report card is about. You (Meg) say that the student has a bad report card and is afraid of his father, and that he says someone coughed in class.
b1-20-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what the student's problem is and what he says.
cues: Say that the student has a bad report card and is afraid of his father
Say what he says happened in class
b1-20-consolidation.target: A diáknak rossz a bizonyítványa, ezért fél az apjától. Szerinte az órán valaki köhögött.
b1-20-consolidation.english: The student has a bad report card, so he is afraid of his father. According to him, someone coughed in class.
b1-20-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a mistake and an excuse in a few sentences.

b1-21-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Just a Rumour
b1-21-01.scenario: Petra says she is worried about the library. You (Meg) say that, supposedly, the library will be closed from next month, but that you only heard it.
b1-21-01.prompt: Tell Petra the rumour and say it is only hearsay.
cues: Say that it is only hearsay
Say what will happen and from when
b1-21-01.target: Állítólag a könyvtár a jövő hónaptól zárva lesz.
b1-21-01.english: Supposedly the library will be closed from next month.
b1-21-01.canDo: I can say that something is only hearsay, using állítólag.

b1-21-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Will Károly Come?
b1-21-02.scenario: Petra asks whether Károly will come to the party. You (Meg) say that he will probably come, but that it is not certain.
b1-21-02.prompt: Tell Petra how sure you are that Károly will come.
cues: Say that he will probably come
Say that it is not certain
b1-21-02.target: Károly valószínűleg eljön, de nem biztos.
b1-21-02.english: Károly will probably come, but it is not certain.
b1-21-02.canDo: I can say how sure I am, using valószínűleg and kétségtelenül.

b1-21-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Better Café
b1-21-03.scenario: Károly does not believe that the new café is better. You (Meg) back up your opinion with facts: the coffee is cheaper and there are more guests.
b1-21-03.prompt: Tell Károly how you back up your opinion.
cues: Say that you back up your opinion with facts
Say the two facts: price and guests
b1-21-03.target: Az álláspontomat tényekkel támasztom alá: a kávé olcsóbb, és több a vendég.
b1-21-03.english: I back up my opinion with facts: the coffee is cheaper and there are more guests.
b1-21-03.canDo: I can back up an opinion with arguments and facts.

b1-21-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Another Viewpoint
b1-21-04.scenario: Petra suggests holding the meeting on Friday. You (Meg) say that you partly agree with the proposal, but that there is another viewpoint.
b1-21-04.prompt: Tell Petra that you partly agree and that you see another viewpoint.
cues: Say that you partly agree with the proposal
Say there is another viewpoint
b1-21-04.target: Részben egyetértek a javaslattal, de van egy másik szempont is.
b1-21-04.english: I partly agree with the proposal, but there is another viewpoint as well.
b1-21-04.canDo: I can say that I partly agree with someone.

b1-21-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Best Proposal
b1-21-05.scenario: Károly asks why you (Meg) prefer this proposal. You say that it is the best proposal you have heard so far, because the facts back it up.
b1-21-05.prompt: Tell Károly why this proposal is convincing.

b1-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Nemecsek and Áts Feri
b1-27-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri in the story. You (Meg) say that Nemecsek said he stays with his friends and does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri.
cues: Say what Nemecsek told Áts Feri
Say that he does not go away
b1-27-consolidation.target: Nemecsek azt mondta Áts Ferinek, hogy a barátaival marad. Nem megy el.
b1-27-consolidation.english: Nemecsek told Áts Feri that he stays with his friends. He does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a boy who stays faithful to his friends, in a few sentences.

b1-28-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rules at the Factory
b1-28-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the rules are at the factory. You (Meg) say that making phone calls is forbidden there and that wearing a cap is mandatory.
b1-28-01.prompt: Tell Petra what is forbidden and what is mandatory at the factory.
cues: Say what is forbidden at the factory
Say what is mandatory there
b1-28-01.target: A gyárban tilos telefonálni. Sapkát kötelező viselni.
b1-28-01.english: At the factory it is forbidden to make phone calls. It is mandatory to wear a cap.
b1-28-01.canDo: I can say what is forbidden or mandatory, with tilos and kötelező + infinitive.

b1-28-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Work Still to Do
b1-28-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is still open at work. You (Meg) say that there is one task still to be solved and that the amount to be paid is large.
b1-28-02.prompt: Tell Károly what task is still open and how large the amount is.
cues: Say that a task is still to be solved
Say that the amount to be paid is large
b1-28-02.target: Van egy megoldandó feladat. A fizetendő összeg nagy.
b1-28-02.english: There is a task to be solved. The amount to be paid is large.
b1-28-02.canDo: I can say what has to be done, with -andó/-endő participles like megoldandó.

b1-28-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Exception for a Student
b1-28-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the teacher decided about a student who was ill. You (Meg) say that out of fairness the teacher made an exception for the ill student.
b1-28-03.prompt: Tell Petra what the teacher did for the ill student.
cues: Say who made the exception
Say why the teacher did it
Say who the exception was for
b1-28-03.target: A tanár méltányosságból kivételt tett a beteg diákkal.
b1-28-03.english: Out of fairness the teacher made an exception for the ill student.
b1-28-03.canDo: I can make or refuse an exception, with kivételt tesz and méltányosságból.

b1-28-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Guarantee on the Phone
b1-28-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the manufacturer promised when she bought the new phone. You (Meg) say that the manufacturer gives a guarantee on the phone for three years.
b1-28-04.prompt: Tell Károly what the manufacturer promised for the phone.
cues: Say who gives the guarantee
Say how long it lasts
Say what it covers
b1-28-04.target: A gyártó három évre garanciát nyújt a telefonra.
b1-28-04.english: The manufacturer gives a guarantee on the phone for three years.
b1-28-04.canDo: I can undertake a commitment or give a guarantee, with kötelezettséget vállal and garanciát nyújt.

b1-28-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Rejection
b1-28-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what her colleague is doing about the rejection of his request. You (Meg) say that the colleague appeals against the decision and demands justice.
b1-28-05.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague does against the decision.
cues: Say that your colleague appeals
Say that he demands justice
b1-28-05.target: A kollégám fellebbez a döntés ellen. Igazságot követel.
b1-28-05.english: My colleague appeals against the decision. He demands justice.
b1-28-05.canDo: I can say that someone appeals against a decision, with jogorvoslattal él and fellebbez.

b1-28-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Red Umbrella
b1-28-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Szent Péter esernyője is about. You (Meg) say that György looked for the money in the umbrella but found Veronka instead.
b1-28-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what György looked for and what he found.
cues: Say what György looked for
Say whom he found
b1-28-consolidation.target: György a pénzt kereste az esernyőben. Veronkát találta meg.
b1-28-consolidation.english: György looked for the money in the umbrella. He found Veronka.
b1-28-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a lawyer, a priest's sister and a red umbrella, in a few sentences.

b1-29-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why They Left
b1-29-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why so many families left the country in the past. You (Meg) say that because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.prompt: Tell Petra why many families left the country.
cues: Say what the reason was
Say what the families chose
b1-29-01.target: A háború miatt sok család választotta a kivándorlást.
b1-29-01.english: Because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.canDo: I can say why people leave, with miatt and következtében.

b1-29-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Family
b1-29-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg where the new family settled and how the children are doing. You (Meg) say that the family settled in Budapest and that the children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.prompt: Tell Károly where the family settled and how the children are doing.
cues: Say where the family settled
Say how the children adapted
b1-29-02.target: A család Budapesten telepedett le. A gyerekek gyorsan alkalmazkodtak a helyi szokásokhoz.
b1-29-02.english: The family settled in Budapest. The children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.canDo: I can say where people settle and how they adapt, with letelepedik and alkalmazkodik vmihez.

b1-29-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Old Neighbour
b1-29-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg about an old neighbour who lives far from his village. You (Meg) say that he lives far away but is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.prompt: Tell Petra how your old neighbour feels about his homeland.
cues: Say that he lives far away
Say what he is attached to
b1-29-03.target: Messze él, de a szülőföldjéhez mindig kötődik.
b1-29-03.english: He lives far away, but he is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.canDo: I can say where I belong and what I am attached to, with tartozik and kötődik vmihez.

b1-29-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Colleague
b1-29-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg about a new colleague. You (Meg) say that his family comes from an old Hungarian family and that his mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.prompt: Tell Petra where your colleague's family comes from and what his mother tongue is.
cues: Say where his family comes from
Say what his mother tongue is
b1-29-04.target: A családja egy régi magyar családból származik. Az anyanyelve magyar.
b1-29-04.english: His family comes from an old Hungarian family. His mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.canDo: I can say where my family comes from, with származik vhonnan.

b1-29-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Feeling at Home
b1-29-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the new family feels in the town. You (Meg) say that after the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.prompt: Tell Petra how the family feels after the welcome.
cues: Say what happened first
Say how the family feels now
b1-29-05.target: A család a befogadás után otthon érzi magát.
b1-29-05.english: After the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.canDo: I can say that someone feels at home, with otthon érzi magát.

b1-29-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Márai Far from Home
b1-29-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Márai is about. You (Meg) say that Márai lived far from his homeland but always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra how Márai lived and which language he wrote in.
cues: Say where Márai lived
Say which language he always wrote in
b1-29-consolidation.target: Márai messze élt, de mindig magyarul írt.
b1-29-consolidation.english: Márai lived far away, but he always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a writer who leaves home and keeps his mother tongue, in a few sentences.

b1-30-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Friend
b1-30-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what a good friend is like. You (Meg) say that a good friend is a person who respects other people's culture.
b1-30-01.prompt: Tell Petra what kind of person a good friend is.
cues: Say who a good friend is
Say what he or she respects
b1-30-01.target: Jó barát az az ember, aki tiszteli mások kultúráját.
b1-30-01.english: A good friend is a person who respects other people's culture.
b1-30-01.canDo: I can describe a person or a thing with a chain of relative clauses, with aki, ami and amely.

b1-30-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Novel
b1-30-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she thought of the novel she read. You (Meg) say that it was an unforgettable experience.
b1-30-02.prompt: Tell Károly what you thought of the novel.
cues: Say which book you mean
Say that it was unforgettable
b1-30-02.target: Ez a regény felejthetetlen élmény volt.
b1-30-02.english: This novel was an unforgettable experience.
b1-30-02.canDo: I can describe something with adjectives in -hatatlan/-hetetlen, like felejthetetlen.

b1-30-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Old Folk Songs
b1-30-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the old folk songs survived. You (Meg) say that the folk songs passed from generation to generation.
b1-30-03.prompt: Tell Petra how the folk songs survived.
cues: Say what passed on
Say how they passed on
b1-30-03.english: The folk songs passed from generation to generation.
b1-30-03.canDo: I can say that customs pass from one generation to the next, with nemzedékről nemzedékre.

b1-30-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Special Holiday
b1-30-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is special in Hungary. You (Meg) say that, in contrast to other peoples, the name day is important here.
b1-30-04.prompt: Tell Károly what is different here.
cues: Say what you contrast with
Say what is important here
b1-30-04.target: Ellentétben más népekkel, nálunk fontos a névnap.
b1-30-04.english: In contrast to other peoples, the name day is important with us.
b1-30-04.canDo: I can contrast cultures, with ellentétben and eltérően.

b1-30-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Translator
b1-30-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what a literary translator does. You (Meg) say that a translator forms a bridge between two languages.
b1-30-05.prompt: Tell Petra what a translator does.
cues: Say who forms the bridge
Say between what
b1-30-05.target: A műfordító hidat képez két nyelv között.
b1-30-05.english: A translator forms a bridge between two languages.
b1-30-05.canDo: I can say how culture is shared, with hidat képez and hozzáférhetővé tesz.

b1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Old Teacher
b1-30-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Abigél is about. You (Meg) say that the old teacher helps the girls and that Gina loves him.
b1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what the teacher does and how Gina feels.
cues: Say whom the teacher helps
Say how Gina feels about him
b1-30-consolidation.target: A tanár úr segít a lányoknak. Gina szereti őt.
b1-30-consolidation.english: The teacher helps the girls. Gina loves him.
b1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a girl in a strict school and a teacher who helps her, in a few sentences.

b1-31-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Metro
b1-31-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg when the new metro starts running. You (Meg) say that it is expected to start next summer and that, with good chances, many people will use it.
b1-31-01.prompt: Tell Petra when the new metro is expected to start and that many people will probably use it.
cues: Say when the metro is expected to start
Say that many people will probably use it, and how likely that is
b1-31-01.target: Az új metró várhatóan jövő nyáron indul. Jó eséllyel sokan fogják használni.
b1-31-01.english: The new metro is expected to start next summer. With good chances many people will use it.
b1-31-01.canDo: I can say how likely something is with várhatóan, előreláthatólag and jó eséllyel.

b1-31-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Working From Home
b1-31-02.scenario: Károly says that more and more people work from home. You (Meg) say that remote work is gaining more and more ground and that the world of work is changing.
b1-31-02.prompt: Tell Károly what is gaining ground and what is happening to the world of work.
cues: Say what is gaining ground
Say that the world of work is changing
b1-31-02.target: A távmunka egyre nagyobb teret hódít. A munka világa most átalakulóban van.
b1-31-02.english: Remote work is gaining more and more ground. The world of work is in the process of transforming now.
b1-31-02.canDo: I can say that a trend is gaining ground with teret hódít.

b1-31-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Tasks Ahead
b1-31-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks the city should do about the future. You (Meg) say that a lot of work still lies ahead and that climate change is a task to be solved today.
b1-31-03.prompt: Tell Petra that much work lies ahead and which task must be solved.
cues: Say that much work still lies ahead
Say which task has to be solved
b1-31-03.target: Sok elvégzendő munka vár még ránk. A klímaváltozás ma egy megoldandó feladat.
b1-31-03.english: Much work to be done still awaits us. Climate change is a task to be solved today.
b1-31-03.canDo: I can name a task that is still ahead with a participle in -andó/-endő.

b1-31-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Fear and Hope
b1-31-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she feels about the future. You (Meg) say that many people fear that machines will take their work, but that the ideas of the young give cause for optimism.
b1-31-04.prompt: Tell Károly what many people fear and what gives you cause for optimism.
cues: Say what many people fear
Say what gives you cause for optimism
b1-31-04.target: Sokan tartanak attól, hogy a gépek elveszik a munkájukat. A fiatalok ötletei bizakodásra adnak okot.
b1-31-04.english: Many people fear that machines will take their work. The ideas of the young give cause for optimism.
b1-31-04.canDo: I can say what causes concern or gives cause for hope with aggodalmat kelt and bizakodásra ad okot.

b1-31-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Decisions Today
b1-31-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg how today's decisions about energy will look in the future. You (Meg) say that from the perspective of twenty years we see them differently and that every decision today has serious consequences.
b1-31-05.prompt: Tell Petra how we will see today's decisions in twenty years and that they have consequences.
cues: Say from what distance in time you look
Say that today's decisions have serious consequences
b1-31-05.target: Húsz év távlatából másként látjuk a mai döntéseket. Minden mai döntésünk súlyos következményekkel jár.
b1-31-05.english: From the perspective of twenty years we see today's decisions differently. Every decision of ours today has serious consequences.
b1-31-05.canDo: I can look ahead with húsz év távlatából.

b1-31-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Éva and Ádám
b1-31-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how Madách's story ends. You (Meg) say that Éva tells Ádám she is expecting a child and that Ádám gets hope again.
b1-31-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what Éva tells Ádám and what Ádám feels afterwards.
cues: Say what Éva tells Ádám
Say what Ádám gets afterwards
b1-31-consolidation.target: Éva azt mondja Ádámnak, hogy gyereket vár. Ádám újra reményt kap.
b1-31-consolidation.english: Éva tells Ádám that she is expecting a child. Ádám gets hope again.
b1-31-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences how Ádám finds hope at the end of Az ember tragédiája.

b1-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Plan Is Clear
b1-32-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg whether the team can decide today. You (Meg) say that the facts are clear, so you have to decide, and that the plan is also cheap.
b1-32-01.prompt: Tell Petra what follows from the facts and add one more argument for the plan.
cues: Say that the facts are clear and what follows from that
Add one more argument for the plan
b1-32-01.target: A tények világosak, tehát döntenünk kell. A terv ráadásul olcsó.
b1-32-01.english: The facts are clear, so we have to decide. The plan is also cheap, on top of that.
b1-32-01.canDo: I can draw a conclusion with tehát, ennélfogva and következésképpen.

b1-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Opening the Meeting
b1-32-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg to open the meeting. You (Meg) say that first of all you have to clarify the concepts and that, as far as the decision is concerned, everyone agrees.
b1-32-02.prompt: Open the meeting: say what comes first and what everyone thinks about the decision.
cues: Say what you have to do first
Say what everyone thinks about the decision
b1-32-02.target: Mindenekelőtt tisztáznunk kell a fogalmakat. Ami a döntést illeti, mindenki egyetért.
b1-32-02.english: First of all, we must clarify the concepts. As far as the decision is concerned, everyone agrees.
b1-32-02.canDo: I can open a point with mindenekelőtt and ami a … illeti.

b1-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Idea, a Hard Practice
b1-32-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks of the new plan. You (Meg) say that the idea is good, but that in practice there are many difficulties; still, there is hope.
b1-32-03.prompt: Tell Petra what is good about the plan and what is hard in practice.
cues: Say that the idea is good
Contrast it with the practice
Say that there is still hope
b1-32-03.target: Az ötlet jó, a gyakorlatban azonban sok a nehézség. Mindazonáltal van remény.
b1-32-03.english: The idea is good, but in practice there are many difficulties. Nevertheless, there is hope.
b1-32-03.canDo: I can contrast two ideas with azonban, viszont and mindazonáltal.

b1-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Time Is Pressing
b1-32-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg why the team decides today. You (Meg) say that since time is pressing, you have to decide immediately.
b1-32-04.prompt: Tell Károly why the team has to decide immediately.
cues: Give the reason
Say what the team must do
b1-32-04.target: Mivel az idő sürget, azonnal döntenünk kell.
b1-32-04.english: Since time is pressing, we have to decide immediately.
b1-32-04.canDo: I can give a reason with mivel and tekintettel arra, hogy.

b1-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Plans
b1-32-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg which of the two plans she prefers. You (Meg) say that the former is expensive and the latter is cheap, so you choose the latter.
b1-32-05.prompt: Tell Petra how the two plans differ and which one you choose.
cues: Say what the first plan is like
Say what the second plan is like
Say which one you choose
b1-32-05.target: Az előbbi terv drága, az utóbbi olcsó. Mindezek alapján az utóbbit választom.
b1-32-05.english: The former plan is expensive, the latter is cheap. On the basis of all this I choose the latter.
b1-32-05.canDo: I can refer back to two things with az előbbi and az utóbbi.

b1-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Timár on the Island
b1-32-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg why Timár Mihály stays on the island at the end of Jókai's story. You (Meg) say that he stays on Senki Island and that he is happy there beside Noémi.
b1-32-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly where Timár Mihály stays and how he feels there.
cues: Say where Timár stays
Say who he is with and how he feels there
b1-32-consolidation.target: Timár Mihály a Senki szigetén marad. Ott Noémi mellett boldog.
b1-32-consolidation.english: Timár Mihály stays on Senki Island. There he is happy beside Noémi.
b1-32-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences why Timár Mihály stays on Senki Island at the end of Az arany ember.

b1-33-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is Petra?
b1-33-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg where Petra is. You (Meg) say that Petra told you she is ill and that she will work the next day.
cues: Say what Petra said about how she is
Say what she said about the next day
b1-33-01.target: Petra azt mondta, hogy beteg. Azt mondta, hogy másnap dolgozik.
b1-33-01.english: Petra said that she is ill. She said that she would work the next day.
b1-33-01.canDo: I can report what someone said with azt mondta, hogy ….

b1-33-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Spokesperson
b1-33-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the spokesperson said about the new program. You (Meg) say that he announced a new program and stressed that the situation is stable.
b1-33-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the spokesperson announced and stressed.
cues: Say what he announced
Say what he emphasized
b1-33-02.target: A szóvivő bejelentette, hogy új program indul. Hangsúlyozta, hogy a helyzet stabil.
b1-33-02.english: The spokesperson announced that a new program is starting. He emphasized that the situation is stable.
b1-33-02.canDo: I can report an official statement with bejelentette, hogy … and hangsúlyozta, hogy ….

b1-33-03.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Reception
b1-33-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the guest asked at the reception. You (Meg) say that he asked whether the office is still open and when the train arrives.
b1-33-03.prompt: Tell Károly what the guest asked.
cues: Say what he asked about the office
Say what he asked about the train
b1-33-03.target: Azt kérdezte, hogy nyitva van-e még az iroda. Érdeklődött, hogy mikor érkezik meg a vonat.
b1-33-03.english: He asked whether the office is still open. He inquired when the train arrives.
b1-33-03.canDo: I can report a yes/no question with hogy … -e.

b1-33-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Doctor's Advice
b1-33-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the doctor said. You (Meg) say that the doctor told the patient to rest a lot.
b1-33-04.prompt: Tell Petra what the doctor told the patient.
cues: Say who gave the instruction
Say what the patient has to do
b1-33-04.target: Az orvos arra utasította a beteget, hogy pihenjen sokat.
b1-33-04.english: The doctor instructed the patient to rest a lot.
b1-33-04.canDo: I can report a command with hogy and -jon/-jen.

b1-33-05.title: Communicative Challenge: News From the Village
b1-33-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg what people say about the village and its old manor. You (Meg) say that allegedly a miracle happened in the village and that rumor has it that a great fortune is hidden in the old manor.
b1-33-05.prompt: Tell Károly what people say about the village and the manor.
cues: Say what allegedly happened in the village
Say what the rumor about the manor is
b1-33-05.target: Állítólag csoda történt a faluban. Úgy hírlik, hogy nagy vagyon rejtőzik a régi kastélyban.
b1-33-05.english: Allegedly a miracle happened in the village. Rumor has it that a great fortune is hidden in the old manor.
b1-33-05.canDo: I can mark a rumour with állítólag and úgy hírlik, hogy ….

b1-33-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Veronka and the Umbrella
b1-33-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to little Veronka in the rain in Mikszáth's story. You (Meg) say that Veronka stayed dry and that a big red umbrella was over her basket.
b1-33-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what happened to Veronka in the rain.
cues: Say how Veronka was in the rain
Say what was over her basket
b1-33-consolidation.target: Veronka száraz maradt az esőben. Egy nagy piros esernyő volt a kosara fölött.
b1-33-consolidation.english: Veronka stayed dry in the rain. A big red umbrella was over her basket.
b1-33-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences how a red umbrella kept little Veronka dry in Szent Péter esernyője.
